items.title: AI股暴跌該買？Yardeni喊進、花旗示警 五大分析師觀點一次看
items.title_en: AI Stocks Plunge: Should You Buy? Yardeni Calls for Entry, Citi Warns; Five Top Analyst Views in One Look
paras: 人工智慧 (AI) 類股遭遇猛烈拋售後，華爾街對進場時機看法分歧。Yardeni Research 認為，資料中心面臨的政治阻力只是 AI 投資熱潮的「減速丘」，股價重挫提供買進機會；花旗則警告，AI 融資疑慮與建設變數尚未消退，科技股仍可能承壓，現階段較看好歐股。
美股週四 (5 日) 遭遇大屠殺，道瓊工業指數重挫 1,833.06 點，標普 500 指數下跌約 4.4%，創 2025 年 4 月關稅衝擊以來最差單日表現，那斯達克指數重挫約 5.5%，較 10 月高點回落約 11.9%，正式跌入修正區間。
《Investing.com》整理華爾街五大 AI 相關分析師觀點指出，除了資料中心建設前景，企業併購代價、AI 商業化能力與軟體需求也成為市場焦點。
Yardeni Research：AI基建只是減速，暴跌提供買進機會
Yardeni Research 表示，自 9 月 15 日起便建議投資人在期中選舉前保持謹慎，並預期選後將出現買進機會。週三股市在空頭回補帶動下上漲，隨後卻急轉直下。
該機構形容：「我們先前警告，民主黨大勝後可能會潑了一盆冷水，這盆水只是晚了一點到。」
Yardeni 指出，投資人開始反映民主黨勝選對美國經濟「金雞母」，也就是 AI 投資熱潮的影響。
該機構引述 NBC 出口民調稱，76% 選民反對在居住社區興建新的資料中心，凸顯地方反彈正在升高。
其中，德州約占美國 2028 年規劃新增資料中心容量的近 30%，新當選州長 Gina Hinojosa 曾承諾暫停核准新案。
Yardeni 並引述高盛估算，可能面臨限制的州，占美國規劃中資料中心容量約 45%。
不過，Yardeni 認為，政治反彈、融資限制及實體建設瓶頸，都只是 AI 熱潮的「減速丘」，市場賣壓已經過頭。
「資料中心仍會興建，只是速度會慢一些。減速丘應有助避免 AI 熱潮衝得太快，在下一個彎道失控。」該機構表示：「這就是我們將上週四拋售視為買進機會的原因。」
TD Cowen、美銀：Marvell遭降評，收購代價偏高
Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) 以全股票方式收購 Lumentum (LITE-US) 的交易，引發分析師對股權稀釋、收購時機與整合效益的疑慮，TD Cowen 與美銀證券均調降評等。
TD Cowen 將 Marvell 由「買進」降至「持有」，目標價由 350 美元大砍至 175 美元。分析師 Sean O’Loughlin 預估，交易在 2028 年首年將使每股盈餘稀釋約中個位數百分比，並擔心收購時點可能接近光通訊短期景氣循環的高峰。
他表示：「我們降評主要是因為對交易結構與時機抱持負面看法，而非質疑 Marvell 所收購資產的品質。」
O’Loughlin 認為，Lumentum 有望成為 Marvell 產品組合中的「皇冠明珠」，但市場對光通訊成長的預期可能過高。依各公司預估加總推算，市場共識隱含 2027 年光收發模組市場規模約達 1,000 億美元，遠高於 TD Cowen 預估的 470 億美元。
若景氣反轉，Lumentum 的營運槓桿可能放大獲利下滑，進一步加重每股盈餘稀釋壓力。
美銀證券則將 Marvell 由「買進」降至「中立」，目標價由 400 美元調降至 225 美元。
分析師 Vivek Arya 肯定交易可建立更完整的電訊號至光訊號連接平台，但指出，交易預計至 2028 年上半年才完成，漫長監管審查可能使股價持續承壓。
Arya 也認為，約 10 億美元成本撙節不足以抵銷約 50% 的股數增加，每股盈餘增益有限，另須留意潛在客戶利益衝突。
他表示，Marvell 最近的分析師日並未提及大型併購，因此這項消息「相當令人意外」，並質疑：「當雷射供應短缺終究獲得解決後，Lumentum 的估值會受到什麼影響？」
花旗：AI賣壓恐未結束，歐股較具吸引力
對整體市場，花旗認為，不能僅依歷史上的期中選舉行情，就預期美股將持續反彈。
該行指出，歷史季節性分析顯示，標普 500 指數在期中選舉年的 11 月至 12 月通常上漲約 3% 至 4%，但今年選前回檔的原因有所不同。
「更重要的是，期中選舉前的回落，主要並非選舉因素，而是 AI 融資疑慮與油價。」花旗表示。
花旗仍預期，強勁運算需求將支持資料中心持續興建，但民主黨勝選後，建設地點、設計與施工速度都可能改變。
該行直言，這對提供 AI 基礎建設所需設備的供應商，包括半導體業者，「遠非理想情況」。
此外，花旗追蹤標普 500 七大權值股中，有多少檔跌破 200 日均線的「Generals」指標，已接近發出警戒訊號，預期資金短期內仍將從科技股轉出。
相較之下，花旗較偏好歐股，認為油價大幅回落對歐洲企業與經濟的助益更大，也可能讓歐洲央行採取更偏向寬鬆的立場。
「由於 AI 題材仍面臨困境，而油價大跌對歐股的幫助更大，我們偏好透過歐洲市場布局。」花旗表示，至少預期歐股表現將優於美股。
花旗：Adobe恐迎營運大重整，降評至「賣出」
花旗另將 Adobe (ADBE-US) 評等調降至「賣出」，目標價由 250 美元降至 207 美元，認為管理層交接、競爭加劇與總體經濟壓力，可能使市場對 2027 會計年度成長的預估面臨下修。
分析師指出，Anil Chakravarthy 將於 12 月 1 日接任執行長，但公司同時面臨財務長與數位媒體部門主管等重要職位空缺。
「我們認為，出現大幅重整的風險正在升高。」花旗表示，Adobe 於 12 月初公布第四季財報時，可能提出較疲弱的 2027 會計年度展望。
花旗預期，Adobe 將更倚重 AI 與 Firefly 擴大潛在用戶及月活躍用戶規模，過去仰賴 Creative Cloud 漲價的成長模式則可能轉變。不過，新用戶轉為付費客戶需要時間，加上小型企業需求疲弱，以及網頁式、AI 原生工具競爭，短期內可能壓抑年度經常性收入 (ARR) 成長。
該行估算，轉向用戶成長的策略，可能使 2027 會計年度 ARR 成長率承受約 2 個百分點壓力；先前 Creative Cloud 漲價效益逐漸消退，還可能帶來額外約 0.5 個百分點逆風。
花旗將 Adobe 2027 與 2028 會計年度淨新增 ARR 預估，分別下修約 4.7 億與 5 億美元，降至 15 億及 13.5 億美元；整體 ARR 年增率則估為 5.3% 與 4.5%，較市場預期低約 2 至 3 個百分點。
此外，尚未有效變現的 AI 推論成本，也使花旗將 2027 會計年度非一般公認會計原則 (non-GAAP) 毛利率預估下修 0.7 個百分點。
花旗認為，若公司大幅重整，短期將壓抑股價，但也能爭取時間重建領導團隊、調整策略，並建立較容易達成的成長基礎。
BTIG 等四家機構：企業軟體支出環境持續承壓
HubSpot (HUBS-US) 因第四季展望低於預期，遭 BTIG、KeyBanc、Cantor 與摩根士丹利接連調降評等，反映企業軟體支出環境持續承壓。
HubSpot 第三季固定匯率營收成長 17%，較市場預期高出 2 個百分點，但第四季成長指引降至 12%，低於市場預估的 13.8%。
管理層表示，客戶預算審查更嚴格、對價格更敏感，銷售週期也進一步拉長，這些情況可能延續至 2027 年。
公司第三季淨新增客戶 5,300 家，低於預期的 5,600 家，第四季預估將少於 5,000 家；淨營收留存率則由去年同期的 103% 降至 101%，顯示既有客戶帶來的營收擴張動能減弱。
BTIG 將評等由「買進」降至「中立」，並將 2027 年成長預估由 14% 下修至 11%。分析師 Nick Altmann 認為，以約 10 倍的 2027 年預估自由現金流估值來看，目前股價已屬合理。
KeyBanc 分析師 Jackson Ader 將評等降至「與產業相當」，表示：「我們承認這次降評較晚，但在明年 2 月正式公布 2027 年財測前，我們認為改善空間有限。」
Cantor 將 HubSpot 降至「減碼」，目標價設為 170 美元。
分析師 Matthew VanVliet 指出，公司新的歐洲定價實際上相當於降價，AI 工具的表現也落後同業。
「我們不再將 HubSpot 視為值得市場持續給予信任的頂尖 SaaS 企業。」他表示。
摩根士丹利也將HubSpot評等由「加碼」降至「中立」，目標價由 287 美元調降至 229 美元。
paras_en: After a fierce sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, Wall Street is split on timing a market entry. Yardeni Research sees the political resistance facing data centers as merely a "slow‑down hill" in the AI investment boom, making the price drop a buying opportunity; Citi warns that AI financing concerns and construction variables have not faded, tech stocks may still be under pressure, and it currently favors European equities.

U.S. equities suffered a massacre on Thursday (the 5th), with the Dow Jones Industrial Average plunging 1,833.06 points, the S&P 500 falling about 4.4% – its worst single‑day performance since the tariff shock of April 2025 – and the Nasdaq tumbling roughly 5.5%, retreating about 11.9% from its October peak and officially entering correction territory.

Investing.com compiled five major Wall Street analyst viewpoints on AI, noting that beyond data‑center construction prospects, corporate‑M&A pricing, AI commercialization capabilities and software demand have also become market focal points.
Yardeni Research: AI infrastructure is only slowing, the crash offers a buying chance

Yardeni Research said it has been urging investors to stay cautious ahead of the midterm elections since September 15 and expects buying opportunities after the election. The market rose on Wednesday on short‑covering, then sharply reversed.
The firm described it as: "We warned that a big Democratic win might pour a bucket of cold water, only that the water arrived a bit later."
Yardeni noted investors are beginning to reflect on how a Democratic victory could act as a "golden goose" for the U.S. economy, influencing the AI investment surge.
The firm cited an NBC poll showing 76% of voters oppose building new data centers in their residential neighborhoods, highlighting rising local backlash.
Texas accounts for nearly 30% of the U.S. planned new data‑center capacity by 2028, and the newly elected governor Gina Hinojosa has pledged to pause approvals for new projects.
Yardeni also quoted Goldman Sachs estimating that states likely to impose restrictions represent about 45% of the planned U.S. data‑center capacity.
However, Yardeni believes political pushback, financing limits and physical‑construction bottlenecks are merely "slow‑down hills" in the AI boom, and market selling pressure is now overdone.

"Data centers will still be built, just at a slower pace. The slowdown hill should help prevent the AI frenzy from accelerating too fast and losing control on the next bend," the firm said, adding: "That’s why we view last Thursday’s sell‑off as a buying opportunity."
TD Cowen and BofA: Marvell downgraded, acquisition price seen as high

Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US)’s all‑stock acquisition of Lumentum (LITE‑US) has sparked analyst concerns over equity dilution, timing and integration benefits, prompting TD Cowen and Bank of America Securities to cut their ratings.

TD Cowen lowered Marvell from "Buy" to "Hold" and slashed the target price from $350 to $175. Analyst Sean O’Loughlin estimates the deal will dilute EPS by a low‑single‑digit percentage in 2028’s first year and worries the timing may coincide with the peak of the short‑term optical‑communications cycle.
He said, "We downgrade mainly because of a negative view on the deal structure and timing, not because we doubt the quality of the assets Marvell is acquiring."

O’Loughlin believes Lumentum could become the "crown jewel" of Marvell’s product portfolio, but market expectations for optical‑communications growth may be overstated. Summing company forecasts, consensus implies a 2027 optical transceiver market of about $100 billion, far above TD Cowen’s $47 billion estimate.
If the cycle turns, Lumentum’s operating leverage could amplify profit declines, further increasing EPS dilution pressure.
BofA Securities cut Marvell from "Buy" to "Neutral" and reduced the target price from $400 to $225.

Analyst Vivek Arya praised the deal’s potential to create a more complete electrical‑to‑optical signal platform, but warned the transaction won’t close until the first half of 2028, and a lengthy regulatory review could keep the stock under pressure.

Arya also noted that roughly $1 billion in cost savings is insufficient to offset about a 50% increase in share count, limiting EPS accretion, and flagged potential conflicts of interest with customers.

He said Marvell’s recent analyst day didn’t mention a large acquisition, making the news "quite surprising," and questioned: "When laser‑supply shortages are finally resolved, how will Lumentum’s valuation be affected?"
Citi: AI selling pressure may not be over, European stocks look more attractive
Regarding the broader market, Citi believes one cannot assume a continued U.S. rally solely based on historical midterm‑election patterns.

The bank points out that seasonal analysis shows the S&P 500 typically gains about 3%‑4% from November to December in election years, but this year’s pre‑election pullback stemmed from different reasons.
"More importantly, the pre‑election dip was driven not by the election itself but by AI financing concerns and oil prices," Citi said.
Citi still expects strong computing demand to support ongoing data‑center construction, yet a Democratic win could alter locations, designs and build speeds.
The firm bluntly stated this is far from ideal for suppliers of AI‑infrastructure equipment, including semiconductor makers.

Additionally, Citi tracks how many of the S&P 500’s seven mega‑caps have fallen below their 200‑day moving average – the "Generals" metric – which is nearing a warning signal, suggesting capital may continue shifting out of tech stocks in the short term.
By contrast, Citi leans toward European equities, believing the sharp oil‑price decline benefits European companies and economies more and could push the ECB toward a more accommodative stance.

"Because AI themes still face headwinds and oil‑price drops help European stocks more, we prefer positioning through the European market," Citi said, expecting European performance to at least outpace U.S. stocks.
Citi: Adobe likely to undergo major restructuring, rating cut to "Sell"

Citi also downgraded Adobe (ADBE‑US) to "Sell," lowering the target price from $250 to $207, citing management turnover, heightened competition and macro‑economic pressure that could force a downgrade of its FY 2027 growth outlook.
Analysts note that Anil Chakravarthy will assume the CEO role on Dec 1, while the company also faces vacancies for CFO and digital‑media head positions.
"We see the risk of a significant restructuring rising," Citi said, adding that Adobe’s Q4 earnings release in early December may present a weaker FY 2027 outlook.

Citi expects Adobe to rely more on AI and Firefly to expand its potential and monthly active user base, while its historic growth model of Creative Cloud price hikes may shift. However, converting new users to paying customers takes time, and weak demand from small businesses, plus competition from web‑based and AI‑native tools, could suppress ARR growth in the near term.

The bank estimates that the shift toward user‑growth could shave roughly 2 percentage points off FY 2027 ARR growth, while the fading benefit of Creative Cloud price hikes could add another 0.5‑point headwind.

Citi trimmed Adobe’s FY 2027 and FY 2028 net new ARR forecasts by about $470 million and $500 million respectively, to $1.5 billion and $1.35 billion; overall ARR growth rates are now seen at 5.3% and 4.5%, roughly 2‑3 points below market expectations.
Furthermore, un‑realized AI inference costs led Citi to lower its FY 2027 non‑GAAP gross‑margin estimate by 0.7 percentage points.
Citi believes a major restructuring would weigh on the stock in the short term but would also buy time to rebuild the leadership team, adjust strategy and lay a more achievable growth foundation.
BTIG and three other firms: Corporate software spending remains under pressure
HubSpot (HUBS‑US) saw its rating cut by BTIG, KeyBanc, Cantor and Morgan Stanley after a Q4 outlook that fell short of expectations, reflecting continued pressure on corporate software spending.
HubSpot’s Q3 constant‑currency revenue grew 17%, beating market forecasts by 2 points, but its Q4 growth guide was lowered to 12%, below the consensus 13.8% estimate.
Management said customers are tightening budget reviews, becoming more price‑sensitive, and lengthening sales cycles, trends that could persist into 2027.

The company added 5,300 net new customers in Q3, below the expected 5,600, and projects fewer than 5,000 in Q4; net revenue retention slipped from 103% a year ago to 101%, indicating weaker expansion from existing accounts.

BTIG downgraded the rating from "Buy" to "Neutral" and cut the 2027 growth outlook from 14% to 11%. Analyst Nick Altmann said that at roughly a 10‑times 2027 free‑cash‑flow valuation, the current share price appears reasonable.

KeyBanc analyst Jackson Ader lowered the rating to "Equal‑Weight," noting, "We acknowledge this downgrade comes later, but ahead of the formal FY 2027 guidance in February, we see limited upside potential."
Cantor reduced HubSpot to "Underweight" with a target price of $170.
Analyst Matthew VanVliet pointed out that the company’s new European pricing is effectively a discount and its AI tools lag behind peers.
"We no longer view HubSpot as a top‑tier SaaS company worthy of continued market confidence," he said.
Morgan Stanley also cut HubSpot’s rating from "Overweight" to "Neutral," lowering the target price from $287 to $229.

items.title: 記憶體股基本面強卻遭低估？高盛估鎧俠本益比僅2.1倍、AI需求能否撐起長期獲利成關鍵
items.title_en: Strong Fundamentals of Memory Stocks Yet Undervalued? Goldman Sachs Estimates Kioxia’s P/E at Only 2.1x, AI Demand May Be Key to Sustaining Long‑Term Profits
paras: 記憶體族群基本面持續轉強，股價估值卻仍處於低檔。高盛預估，鎧俠（Kioxia）2028會計年度本益比僅約2.1倍，若以公允價值計算則約7.2倍。BNS、野村證券與摩根大通也在同一周接連分析記憶體股的風險報酬，凸顯市場對族群評價偏低的關注。
不過，儘管賣方機構陸續釋出正面看法，股價卻未立即反映。市場對記憶體股的疑慮，並非只在於未來一兩年的獲利表現，而是這波景氣能否延續，以及目前的高獲利能否成為長期常態。
記憶體產業過去的景氣循環經驗，是市場遲遲不願給予更高評價的原因之一。每逢產業進入景氣高峰，市場往往會以客戶需求更強、產品複雜度提高及需求穩定性改善等理由，認為這次循環有所不同，但隨著價格回落，企業獲利通常也會同步下滑。
因此，即使目前長期供貨協議（LTA）、產能滿載及DDR5產品溢價等因素支撐產業基本面，投資人仍會考量合約續約後的價格變化，以及2027年以後的需求能否維持。
另一項關鍵在於市場如何評估2029年以後的獲利能力。即使鎧俠2028會計年度本益比僅2倍多，也不代表投資人看壞2027年的獲利，而是對目前的高獲利能否持續抱持疑慮。
如果市場將現階段獲利視為景氣循環高峰，並預期未來獲利將明顯收縮，即使本益比偏低，也有其合理性。反之，若AI帶動的記憶體需求能夠長期推升產業獲利中樞，市場才可能願意給予更高的估值倍數。
此外，機構投資人的操作考量，也可能延後股價重新評價的時間。即使基金經理人認為個別企業估值偏低，也未必願意率先布局，因為市場重新評價的時點難以預測，若提前進場，可能連續數季落後大盤基準。即使最終投資判斷正確，等待期間的績效壓力仍可能影響投資決策。
中國業者帶來的供給風險，則是另一項估值折價因素。長江存儲（YMTC）的NAND競爭力、長鑫科技(688825-CN) 的DRAM擴產，以及美國出口管制政策的後續走向，都可能改變未來記憶體市場的供需結構。
由於這些變數難以精確量化，市場可能傾向透過壓低估值倍數來反映潛在風險，而非對各項風險給出明確的發生機率。
高盛、BNS、野村證券與摩根大通在同一周從不同角度分析記憶體股的風險報酬，也可能有助於降低機構投資人率先布局的心理門檻。當多家大型機構同步提出相關投資觀點，基金經理人即使選擇進場，也較容易向市場及投資人說明其決策依據。
不過，賣方報告集中釋出，僅代表市場觀點逐漸收斂，並不意味股價即將啟動重新評價。
後續觀察重點包括2027年以後長期供貨協議的續約價格、企業管理層對2029年以後供需前景的看法，以及2026年第四季財報期間，機構投資人的持股是否出現變化。
若這些指標進一步證實AI記憶體需求具有長期支撐力，市場目前給予的低估值就可能從反映景氣循環風險，轉為潛在的市場錯價；反之，若缺乏足夠證據，即使本益比只有2倍多，也可能只是投資人為產業週期風險預留的折價空間。
paras_en: The fundamentals of the memory sector continue to strengthen, yet the valuation of the stocks remains low. Goldman Sachs estimates that Kioxia’s price‑to‑earnings ratio for fiscal year 2028 will be only about 2.1 times; if calculated at fair value it would be about 7.2 times. BNS, Nomura Securities, and JPMorgan also released risk‑reward analyses of memory stocks in the same week, highlighting market concerns about the undervaluation of the sector.

However, despite the sell‑side firms gradually issuing positive views, the stock price has not immediately reflected this. Market concerns about memory stocks are not only about earnings performance in the next one or two years, but whether this economic cycle will continue and whether the current high profitability can become a long‑term norm.

The past cyclical experience of the memory industry is one reason why the market has been reluctant to assign higher valuations. Whenever the industry enters a boom, the market often argues that this cycle is different because of stronger customer demand, increased product complexity, and improved demand stability, but as prices fall, corporate earnings usually decline in tandem.

Therefore, even though long‑term supply agreements (LTAs), full capacity utilization, and DDR5 product premiums support the industry fundamentals, investors will still consider price changes after contract renewals and whether demand can be maintained after 2027.

Another key issue is how the market evaluates profitability after 2029. Even if Kioxia’s P/E for fiscal year 2028 is only a little over 2 times, it does not mean investors are pessimistic about 2027 earnings; rather, they remain skeptical about whether the current high profitability can persist.

If the market views the current profitability as a peak of the economic cycle and expects future earnings to shrink significantly, a low P/E may be reasonable. Conversely, if AI‑driven memory demand can sustain long‑term industry profitability, the market may be willing to assign a higher valuation multiple.

In addition, institutional investors’ operational considerations may delay the time when the stock is re‑valued. Even if portfolio managers believe a particular company is undervalued, they may not be willing to lead the way because the timing of a market re‑valuation is unpredictable; entering early could result in several consecutive quarters lagging the market benchmark. Even if the final investment judgment is correct, performance pressure during the waiting period can still affect investment decisions.

Supply risks from Chinese players represent another discount factor. The competitiveness of YMTC’s NAND, the expansion of DRAM by Changxin Technology (688825‑CN), and the future direction of U.S. export control policies could all alter the future supply‑demand structure of the memory market.
Because these variables are difficult to quantify precisely, the market may prefer to lower valuation multiples to reflect potential risks rather than assign explicit probabilities to each risk.

Goldman Sachs, BNS, Nomura Securities, and JPMorgan’s risk‑reward analyses from different angles in the same week may also help lower the psychological threshold for institutional investors to take the lead. When several large institutions simultaneously present related investment views, fund managers can more easily explain their decision basis to the market and investors if they choose to enter.
However, concentrated sell‑side reports only indicate that market views are gradually converging and do not mean the stock price will immediately start a re‑valuation.

Key follow‑up observations include the renewal price of long‑term supply agreements after 2027, management’s view on supply‑demand prospects after 2029, and whether institutional investors’ holdings change during the Q4 2026 earnings period.

If these indicators further confirm that AI memory demand has long‑term support, the market’s current low valuation may shift from reflecting cyclical risk to a potential market mispricing; conversely, if there is insufficient evidence, even a P/E of just over 2 times may simply be a discount space investors reserve for industry cycle risk.

items.title: 美國債務警報拉響！華爾街估恐觸發「非常規措施」 債限上限最快提前至明年2月觸頂
items.title_en: U.S. Debt Alert Sounds! Wall Street Warns of Possible "Extraordinary Measures" as Debt Ceiling May Hit Its Peak as Early as February Next Year
paras: 華爾街最新預警，美國財政部最快將於2027年2月中下旬觸及41.1兆美元法定債務上限，較原先市場預期明顯提前，屆時須啟動「非常規措施」避開融資斷鏈。
美銀、巴克莱與摩根士丹利策略師指出，美國財政部最新融資估算與偏高的現金餘額，是觸頂時點前移的主因；其中美銀原估5月前後，如今時間已大幅提前。
目前，美國政府距債限僅剩不到8000億美元，財政部上週公布明年第一季淨借款約8000億美元，3月底現金餘額目標訂為1兆美元歷史高位。
若國會未提高或暫停債限，財政部可動用非常規會計手段，額外騰出3000億至3500億美元緩衝。
機構普遍推算，現金與非常規措施耗盡的「X日」將落在2027年8月至11月：美銀看11月，但8月恐先逼臨險區；巴克莱基準情境為8月下旬至9月初，視9月稅收而定，稅收若旺可延至10月；摩根士丹利則估第三季末。
期中選舉後民主黨掌控國會，債限談判陷僵局風險升溫。國際信評機構惠誉此前警告，兩黨邊緣操作恐抬高技術性違約機率。
市場人士表示，若博弈拖延，短期國庫券供給收縮、殖利率曲線扭曲將加劇，全球無風險利率錨定效應亦受考驗。
paras_en: Wall Street’s latest warning says the U.S. Treasury could hit the $41.1 trillion statutory debt ceiling as early as mid‑late February 2027, far earlier than market expectations, and would then have to trigger “extraordinary measures” to avoid a financing break.

Bank of America, Barclays and Morgan Stanley strategists point to the Treasury’s latest financing estimates and a higher‑than‑expected cash balance as the main reasons the peak is moving forward; Bank of America had originally projected a May timeframe, but the date has now been pushed far earlier.

Currently the U.S. government is less than $800 billion away from the debt limit. The Treasury announced last week that net borrowing in the first quarter of next year will be about $800 billion, and it has set a cash‑balance target of $1 trillion at the end of March – a historic high.
If Congress does not raise or suspend the limit, the Treasury can employ extraordinary accounting tools to free an additional $300 billion to $350 billion as a buffer.

Analysts generally estimate that the “X‑day” when cash and extraordinary measures are exhausted will fall between August and November 2027: Bank of America sees November but warns August could already be a danger zone; Barclays’ baseline scenario is late August to early September, depending on September tax receipts – strong receipts could push it to October; Morgan Stanley projects the end of the third quarter.

After the mid‑term elections, Democrats control Congress, raising the risk that debt‑limit negotiations could stall. International rating agency Fitch previously warned that partisan brinkmanship could increase the probability of a technical default.

Market participants say that if the bargaining drags on, short‑term Treasury supply will shrink, the yield curve will become more distorted, and the global risk‑free rate anchoring effect will be tested.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：美國CPI、PPI、英國GDP與中國通膨數據
items.title_en: Trading Notes This Week: US CPI, PPI, UK GDP and China Inflation Data
paras: 全球金融市場剛經歷了動盪的一週，隨著政局塵埃落定，市場焦點將全面轉向經濟數據，檢驗全球主要經濟體的復甦韌性與通膨路徑。
下週全球市場的首要焦點是美國即將公布的 10 月消費者物價指數(CPI)與生產者物價指數(PPI)，美國以外，英國將公布GDP數據、歐元區將公布第 3 季 GDP 第二次修正值。亞洲市場方面，中國將公布 CPI、PPI 及貿易數據。

本週操盤筆記 (1108-1114)

1.美國10月CPI與PPI
市場預測，美國10 月整體 CPI 月增率將由 9 月的 0.6% 放緩至 0.3%，核心 CPI 月增率則預估由 0.3% 微幅降至 0.2%。週五將公布的生產者物價指數月增率預期由 1.3% 放緩至 0.4%。由於去年同期的政府關門因素影響，美國勞工統計局本週將不公布 CPI 的年增數據。
強勁的就業數據使市場預估聯邦準備理事會(Fed)在 12 月會議上維持利率按兵不動的機率上升至約 80%。聯準會近期強調決策將依賴「資訊累積」，旨在引導市場避免過度解讀單一數據。若下週通膨順利放緩，將為聯準會提供更多決策彈性；反之，若服務業通膨依舊頑強，恐進一步推升美債殖利率並支撐美元走勢。
2.英國第三季GDP
英國央行(BoE)上週鷹派升息 25 個基點至 4.0%，並預估 CPI 年增率將於明年第 2 季達到 4.9% 峰值。下週英國將公布第 3 季 GDP 初值(預估年增 1.7%、月增 0.2%)，數據強弱將決定英格蘭銀行是否具備繼續維持限制性高利率的政策空間。
歐元區方面，10 月通膨率回升至 4.0%(能源年增 20.8% 驅動)，但零售銷售月減 0.7%，呈現「高通膨與弱消費」的兩難局勢，下週將公布第 3 季 GDP 第二次修正值。
3.中國通膨數據
中國下週重頭戲為消費者物價指數、生產者物價指數與貿易數據的公布。
目前中國消費通膨偏低，反映市場內需仍顯疲軟。在貨幣政策與匯率調控上，中國人民銀行宣布將外匯存款準備金率調升 2 個百分點，鎖定約 200 億至 250 億美元的流動性，傳遞出終止人民幣單邊升值趨勢的明確訊號。
paras_en: Global financial markets have just endured a turbulent week. With political uncertainties settled, market focus will shift entirely to economic data, testing the recovery resilience and inflation paths of the world’s major economies.

Next week’s primary focus for global markets is the United States’ upcoming October Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI) releases. Outside the US, the UK will publish GDP data and the Eurozone will release the second revision of Q3 GDP. In Asia, China will publish CPI, PPI and trade figures.

This week’s trading notes (Nov 8‑Nov 14)

1. US October CPI and PPI

The market expects the overall US CPI monthly increase for October to slow from September’s 0.6% to 0.3%, with core CPI monthly growth easing slightly from 0.3% to 0.2%. The producer price index monthly rise slated for Friday is forecast to decelerate from 1.3% to 0.4%. Because of the government shutdown effect last year, the Bureau of Labor Statistics will not release the CPI’s annual rate this week.

Strong employment data has lifted the probability that the Federal Reserve will keep rates unchanged at the December meeting to about 80%. The Fed has recently emphasized that decisions will rely on “information accumulation,” aiming to steer the market away from over‑interpreting any single data point. If inflation eases next week, the Fed will gain more policy flexibility; if services‑inflation remains stubborn, it could push US Treasury yields higher and support the dollar.
2. UK Q3 GDP

The Bank of England raised rates by 25 basis points last week to 4.0% and projects the CPI annual rate to peak at 4.9% in Q2 next year. Next week the UK will release the preliminary Q3 GDP figure (forecast 1.7% annual, 0.2% monthly), and the strength of the data will determine whether the BoE retains room to maintain a restrictive high‑rate stance.

In the Eurozone, October inflation rose back to 4.0% (driven by a 20.8% annual increase in energy), while retail sales fell 0.7% month‑on‑month, creating a “high inflation, weak consumption” dilemma. The second revision of Q3 GDP will be published next week.
3. China Inflation Data
China’s headline event next week is the release of its consumer price index, producer price index and trade data.

China’s current consumer inflation is low, reflecting continued weakness in domestic demand. Regarding monetary and exchange‑rate policy, the People’s Bank of China announced a 2‑percentage‑point increase in the foreign‑exchange deposit reserve requirement, locking in roughly $20‑$25 billion of liquidity and sending a clear signal that the unilateral appreciation of the RMB is ending.

items.title: 高市早苗：我十分想見金正恩
items.title_en: Sanae Takahashi: I Really Want to Meet Kim Jong-un
paras: 日本首相高市早苗8日（周日）在東京出席活動時表示，「我真摯地想與金正恩委員長會面，已得到美國總統川普的支持。」
今年3月，在華盛頓舉行的美日峰會會談中，高市早苗對實現日本與北韓兩國領袖會談表示了強烈意願。
北韓勞動黨中央委員會部長金與正對此表示，這並不是日本所願意、做決心就能實現的問題。如果日本首相想要解決北韓不承認的其單方面議題，北韓高層就無意見面，也不會與其面對面坐在一起。
金與正說，兩國元首要見面，日本首先就要下定決心與不合時宜的慣常行為和習性一刀兩斷。但現在日本朝著與之相反的方向越走越遠，北韓與日方沒什麼可談。金與正稱，其個人立場是不希望看到日本首相訪問平壤。
paras_en: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takahashi on Sunday the 8th, while attending an event in Tokyo, said, "I sincerely want to meet Chairman Kim Jong-un, and have received the support of U.S. President Trump."
In March this year, during the US‑Japan summit in Washington, Sanae Takahashi expressed a strong desire to achieve a meeting between the leaders of Japan and North Korea.

North Korea's Workers' Party Central Committee Director Kim Yo‑jong said that this is not something that can be realized simply because Japan is willing and decides to do so. If the Japanese prime minister wants to resolve the unilateral issues that North Korea does not recognize, the North Korean leadership has no intention to meet, nor will they sit face‑to‑face together.

Kim Yo‑jong said that for the two heads of state to meet, Japan must first make a firm decision to break with its untimely habitual practices and customs. But now Japan is moving further in the opposite direction, and there is little for North Korea and Japan to discuss. Kim Yo‑jong stated that personally she does not wish to see the Japanese prime minister visit Pyongyang.

items.title: 黃仁勳之女突然取消訪韓 理由是「家庭因素」
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's Daughter Suddenly Cancels Korea Visit Citing "Family Reasons"
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳長女、輝達物理AI平台產品和技術營銷高級總監黃敏珊突然取消訪韓計畫，她與韓國副總理裴慶勳會面等日程安排隨之告吹。
黃敏珊原本計劃訪韓出席定於本月9日至10日舉行的「2026年輝達首爾AI日」活動。該活動將如期舉行，由輝達其他高層替黃敏珊出席。
據《韓聯社》報導，黃敏珊以「家庭因素」為由取消訪韓，但具體理由不得而知。
據韓方介紹，裴慶勳原定8日下午在首爾汝矣島與黃敏珊會面。她原本還計劃與科技部第二次官（副部長）柳濟明共同主持「韓國AI新創夥伴關係論壇」。
黃仁勳有一兒一女，分別是黃勝斌和黃敏珊。黃敏珊曾當過一段時間廚師，後前往法國奢侈品巨頭LVMH集團工作，2020年以實習生身份加入輝達。黃勝斌則經營酒吧多年，2022年加入輝達。
黃敏珊和黃勝斌入職後頻獲晉升，特別是黃敏珊已成為與執行長核心團隊一同密切籌備輝達重大活動的高層。兩人主要活躍於仿真軟體與機器人業務——輝達近年來重點培育的賽道。
黃仁勳2025年曾經被問及公司「裙帶關係」問題。他坦然承認輝達僱傭了許多員工子女，並表示他不介意，因為他相信這些父母不會推薦讓他們蒙羞的孩子。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang's eldest daughter and senior director of product and technology marketing for NVIDIA's physical AI platform, Huang Minshan, abruptly cancelled her planned visit to South Korea, causing the scheduled meeting with Korean Deputy Prime Minister Bae Kyung-hoon and other engagements to fall through.

Minshan had originally planned to travel to South Korea to attend the "2026 NVIDIA Seoul AI Day" event scheduled for September 9-10. The event will proceed as planned, with other NVIDIA executives standing in for Minshan.
According to the Yonhap News Agency, Minshan cancelled the trip citing "family reasons," though no further details were provided.

South Korean officials said Deputy Prime Minister Bae was set to meet Minshan on the afternoon of the 8th in Yeouido, Seoul. She had also planned to co‑host the "Korea AI Startup Partnership Forum" with the Ministry of Science and ICT's second vice minister, Ryu Ji‑myung.

Jensen Huang has one son and one daughter: Huang Shengbin and Huang Minshan. Minshan once worked as a chef, later joined luxury group LVMH in France, and entered NVIDIA in 2020 as an intern. Shengbin ran a bar for several years before joining NVIDIA in 2022.

Since joining NVIDIA, both Minshan and Shengbin have been promoted repeatedly, with Minshan now a senior executive closely involved with the CEO's core team in planning major company events. Both are primarily active in simulation software and robotics businesses, a strategic focus area for NVIDIA in recent years.

When asked in 2025 about potential nepotism at the company, Jensen Huang openly acknowledged that NVIDIA employs many employees' children, saying he does not mind because he trusts that those parents would not recommend children who would bring shame to the firm.

items.title: 馬斯克揭特斯拉、SpaceX未來布局！太空AI資料中心、Terafab晶圓廠與Optimus機器人全曝光
paras: 馬斯克近日出席第33屆巴倫投資大會，與巴倫資本創辦人、特斯拉(TSLA-US) 及SpaceX(SPCX-US) 長期投資人Ron Baron進行逾一小時對談，談及太空資料中心、Terafab晶圓廠、人形機器人Optimus及SpaceX營收展望等議題。
整場對談中，中國成為馬斯克反覆提及的競爭參照。從電力供應、半導體製造到電動車與人形機器人，他認為美國若要維持AI及科技產業競爭力，必須加快基礎建設與製造能力布局，並將部分運算能力延伸至太空。

中國電力是美國3倍、馬斯克看好太空資料中心

談及AI產業競爭，馬斯克直言，與中國競爭的唯一方法，就是將運算能力送上太空。
他認為，AI訓練與推論最終比拚的是電力供應，而中國目前的發電量約為美國的3倍，美國電廠與電網建設速度則難以跟上資料中心不斷增加的用電需求。
馬斯克進一步指出，太空環境具有能源優勢，太陽能板在軌道上能取得比地面多約30%的太陽能，且不受晝夜及雲層影響，有機會成為支撐大規模AI運算的電力來源。
在具體時程方面，SpaceX與輝達(NVDA-US) 共同設計的首批StarMind太空運算設備，預計最快於2027年第三季開始發射，並在2028年擴大部署。
不過，馬斯克也坦言，這只是他目前的預測。

Terafab瞄準1太瓦晶片產能　馬斯克盼製程效率大幅提升

除了將AI運算延伸至太空，馬斯克也將半導體供應鏈視為美國必須強化的戰略環節。
他指出，全球絕大部分晶片產能集中在亞洲，尤其台灣承擔大量晶片製造工作，美國目前的產能占比則僅約10%。考量相關地區存在地緣政治風險，特斯拉與SpaceX正共同推動Terafab晶片製造計畫，希望建立每年1太瓦的晶片產能。
馬斯克估計，今年全球AI晶片產量約20至25吉瓦，明年可能增至35至45吉瓦。相較之下，Terafab設定的1太瓦目標，規模將遠超目前全球AI晶片產能。
巴倫在對談中估計，這項計畫可能耗資1兆美元，馬斯克並未直接確認這個數字，僅表示公司不會立即需要如此龐大的資金。此前，德州州長辦公室公布的第一期投資估算則超過168億美元。
除了擴大產能，馬斯克也將焦點放在晶圓廠的生產效率。他指出，晶圓在工廠內單純運輸及等待的時間，可能占整體製程時間一半以上，因此希望透過重新設計生產流程，大幅縮短製造週期。
他表示，Terafab將先在奧斯汀興建研究型晶圓廠，希望將原本通常需要一年的工作壓縮至一個月完成。
根據SpaceX先前10月20日財報電話會議公布的規劃，首顆SRAM測試晶片目標於2027年5至6月推出，量產則預計在2028年第三季展開。馬斯克也承認，這項時程相當積極。英特爾(INTC-US) 已宣布加入Terafab計畫。

稱中國車企實力強、Optimus初期成本可能與汽車相近

談到電動車市場，馬斯克罕見直接稱讚中國車廠實力強勁，同時強調特斯拉Model Y仍是中國最暢銷的電動車。
在下一階段的人形機器人競爭上，馬斯克則為Optimus設定相當高的生產力目標，認為人形機器人的最低生產效率應達到人類的5倍。他也估計，美國需要約2,000萬至3,000萬台機器人，才能抵得上全美商品與服務的總產出。
至於製造成本，馬斯克表示，Optimus初期成本可能與汽車相近，但隨著技術成熟及生產規模擴大，未來成本將大幅下降。根據Not a Tesla App整理的資訊，單台機器人的製造成本預計從約3萬美元起步，逐步降至2萬美元。
特斯拉已於上月在加州弗里蒙特工廠一條規劃年產100萬台的產線展開Optimus早期生產，目標在2027年底前後交付外部企業客戶，搭載AI5晶片的版本則預計於2027年4月前後推出。
中國人形機器人業者也正加速推進量產與價格競爭。宇樹科技已將入門款人形機器人R1起售價降至3.99萬元人民幣，小鵬汽車(XPEV-US) 也公布IRON人形機器人的量產時程，市場競爭逐漸升溫。

SpaceX年底年化營收拚千億美元　AI業務成重要成長動能

相較於長期技術布局，馬斯克對SpaceX營收的預測，則是這場對談中最受投資人關注的部分。
他表示，SpaceX正朝12月年化營收突破1,000億美元的目標邁進，除非發生自然災害等意外，否則預期能夠達成。
對於明年營收，馬斯克更預估，SpaceX在2027年12月的年度經常性收入（ARR）可能超過5,000億美元，但強調這並非承諾，而是目前最好的估計。至於ARR達到1兆美元，他認為並非完全不可能，但機率約只有2%。
不過，ARR是以特定時間點的營收速度推算全年規模，並不等同實際全年營收，兩者不能直接比較。
從目前業務結構來看，SpaceX的成長動能也正逐漸從火箭發射及衛星通訊，延伸至AI運算服務。第三季財報顯示，SpaceX的「AI解決方案與基礎設施」業務營收達76億美元，年增830%，已高於以星鏈（Starlink）為主的連線業務52億美元。
馬斯克也提到，AI代理程式產生的網路流量已超過人類流量，星鏈V3衛星的能力則將達到V2的10倍以上。他並表示，SpaceX未來甚至可能考慮收購傳統電信業者，以取得頻譜資源。
至於星艦（Starship），馬斯克預期，在實現完全可重複使用後，發射成本有望降至每公斤100美元以下。他也預告，約一周後將嘗試利用發射塔機械臂回收星艦。
面對外界長期質疑其預測時程過於樂觀，馬斯克則表示，自己的預測目標是落在50百分位，意味著實際進度可能提前，也可能延後。
整體而言，這場對談反映出馬斯克正將特斯拉與SpaceX的長期發展，連結至AI運算、半導體自主製造及人形機器人等領域。從太空資料中心到Terafab，再到Optimus，其布局背後都指向同一個核心問題：如何透過能源、晶片與製造能力，建立面對中國競爭的優勢。
不過，太空運算設備仍處於規劃階段，Terafab量產時程也要到2028年，Optimus的成本、可靠性及商業模式同樣仍有待驗證。這些計畫能否如期落地，將是接下來市場觀察的重點。

items.title: 沙烏地阿拉伯首都金融區遭襲 石油巨頭Saudi Aramco大樓受損
items.title_en: Saudi Arabia's Capital Financial District Attacked, Saudi Aramco Building Damaged
paras: 《法新社》8日（周日）援引目擊者消息報導，沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德金融區遭到襲擊，Saudi Aramco石油公司大樓受損。
當地時間11月8日上午，沙國民防部門向利雅德發布潛在危險預警，隨後市區傳出多聲巨響。民防部門此後宣布危險解除。
當天以沙國為首的多國聯軍發言人圖爾基·馬利基表示，防空部隊攔截並摧毀兩枚由葉門叛軍胡塞向利雅德發射的彈道飛彈。
多國聯軍隨後又宣布，在利雅德地區和沙國南部地區攔截並摧毀兩枚巡弋飛彈。
當天早些時候，聯軍還宣布攔截並摧毀一枚由胡塞向沙國東部發射的彈道飛彈。
此外，沙國民防部門此前在達曼、扎赫蘭、布蓋格等地發布的危險預警也已解除。
扎赫蘭是沙國國家石油巨頭Saudi Aramco總部所在地，其所在的沙國東部省份儲有沙國王國絕大部分石油和天然氣儲量。石油巨頭Saudi Aramco總部此前曾於10月遭受襲擊，損失慘重。
paras_en: AFP reported on Sunday the 8th that the financial district in Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia, was attacked and the Saudi Aramco oil company building was damaged.

On the morning of November 8 local time, Saudi civil defense issued a potential danger alert for Riyadh, after which multiple loud explosions were heard in the city. The civil defense later announced that the danger had been lifted.

Later that day, Turki Al-Maliki, spokesperson for the multinational coalition led by Saudi Arabia, said air‑defense forces intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles launched by Yemen’s Houthi rebels toward Riyadh.
The coalition subsequently announced that it intercepted and destroyed two cruise missiles over the Riyadh area and southern Saudi Arabia.
Earlier that day, the coalition also announced it intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis toward eastern Saudi Arabia.
In addition, earlier civil‑defense alerts issued for Dammam, Zaharan and Buqayq have also been lifted.

Zaharan is the location of Saudi Aramco’s headquarters; the eastern province where it sits holds the vast majority of the kingdom’s oil and gas reserves. Saudi Aramco’s headquarters was previously attacked in October, suffering heavy losses.

items.title: 鴻海參展TASTI 2026 攜集團夥伴展現低軌衛星端到端布局
items.title_en: Foxconn Showcases End-to-End Low‑Earth Orbit Satellite Strategy at TASTI 2026
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)宣布自11月8日至10日參與2026台灣太空國際年會(TASTI 2026)，以「新世代衛星通訊」為主軸，展示第二代珍珠號低軌衛星模型，以及攜手集團夥伴展示衛星通訊模組、陣列式天線、低軌衛星使用者終端及關鍵線材等技術，從單星在軌驗證邁向雙星協同通訊，並進一步布局太空運算及新世代太空基礎設施。
第二代珍珠號PEARL-1A、PEARL-1B於台北時間今年5月3日搭乘SpaceX獵鷹9號(Falcon 9)運載火箭升空，進入距地表約600公里的預定軌道；兩顆衛星延續第一代珍珠號的6U XL架構，單顆重量約9.5公斤，主要執行通訊與太空科學領域的酬載技術驗證，預計在軌執行為期5年的任務。
鴻海研究院新世代通訊研究所所長吳仁銘表示，第二代珍珠號雙星成功進入預定軌道，代表鴻海衛星技術從第一代單星系統驗證，進一步朝雙星協同通訊與太空科學任務發展。透過星間鏈路、電離層觀測及衛星對地寬頻通訊等在軌實驗，將持續累積自主衛星的飛行履歷與實務經驗，並轉化為可延伸、可整合的產業能力。
相較第一代珍珠號著重衛星與地面站之間的寬頻通訊實驗及系統驗證，第二代珍珠號進一步搭載Ka頻段星間鏈路(ISL)酬載，除可進行衛星與地面站之間的寬頻通訊，也將驗證雙星之間的資料傳輸能力。此外，第二代珍珠號也搭載小型電離層探測儀及太陽能電池酬載，進行太空環境觀測與科學實驗，累積衛星設計、系統整合、在軌操作及任務管理經驗。
除衛星平台外，鴻海此次也整合集團通訊技術、硬體設計及系統整合能力，展出多項衛星通訊相關產品。其中，5G地面網路／非地面網路使用者終端數據機模組(5G TN/NTN UT Modem Module)採用聯發科(2454-TW)5G通訊晶片，結合鴻海硬體設計與系統整合能力，布局5G NTN低軌衛星通訊應用。
陣列式天線模組(Phased Array Module)則透過RF高頻波束成形技術，提升低軌衛星通訊效能；RF升降頻模組(RF Up/Down Converter Module)採模組化設計，可相容不同世代類比數據機，展現鴻海從通訊模組、射頻、天線到系統整合的技術布局。
展望未來太空運算及AI應用，鴻海表示，持續發揮在AI、運算、通訊、關鍵零組件、精密製造、系統整合及先進熱管理等領域的優勢，並針對高效散熱與熱傳導等關鍵課題展開早期研究，為AI資料中心技術延伸至衛星及太空運算場景預作準備。也將深化產官學研及國際夥伴合作，逐步建構新世代太空通訊與太空基礎設施所需的技術能力，進一步延伸至太空運算的發展機會。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced that it will participate in the 2026 Taiwan Space International Conference (TASTI 2026) from November 8‑10, focusing on “next‑generation satellite communications.” The company will display a second‑generation Pearl low‑Earth‑orbit satellite model and, together with group partners, demonstrate satellite‑communication modules, phased‑array antennas, LEO user terminals and key cabling technologies, moving from single‑satellite on‑orbit validation to dual‑satellite coordinated communications, and further laying the groundwork for space computing and next‑generation space infrastructure.

The second‑generation Pearl satellites PEARL‑1A and PEARL‑1B were launched on May 3 this year (Taipei time) aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, reaching a planned orbit about 600 km above Earth. Both satellites retain the first‑generation Pearl’s 6U XL bus, weigh roughly 9.5 kg each, and will conduct communications and space‑science payload technology demonstrations, with a planned five‑year on‑orbit mission.

Wu Ren‑ming, director of the New‑Generation Communications Institute at Foxconn Research Center, said the successful insertion of the dual‑satellite second‑generation Pearl into its intended orbit shows Foxconn’s satellite technology has progressed from first‑generation single‑satellite verification to dual‑satellite coordinated communications and space‑science missions. Through on‑orbit experiments such as inter‑satellite links, ionospheric observations and broadband satellite‑to‑ground communications, Foxconn will continue to build flight heritage and practical experience for its autonomous satellites, converting them into extensible, integrated industry capabilities.

Compared with the first‑generation Pearl, which focused on broadband communications experiments and system verification between a satellite and a ground station, the second‑generation Pearl adds a Ka‑band inter‑satellite link (ISL) payload. In addition to broadband satellite‑to‑ground communications, it will also validate data‑transfer capability between the two satellites. Moreover, the new Pearl carries a small ionospheric probe and a solar‑cell payload for space‑environment monitoring and scientific experiments, further accumulating experience in satellite design, system integration, on‑orbit operation and mission management.

Beyond the satellite platform, Foxconn also integrated the group’s communications technology, hardware design and system‑integration expertise to showcase several satellite‑communication products. The 5G ground‑network/non‑ground‑network user‑terminal modem module (5G TN/NTN UT Modem Module) uses MediaTek’s (2454‑TW) 5G chip, combined with Foxconn’s hardware design and system‑integration capabilities to position itself for 5G NTN low‑Earth‑orbit satellite communication applications.

The phased‑array antenna module employs RF high‑frequency beam‑forming technology to boost LEO satellite communication performance. The RF up/down‑converter module uses a modular design that can be compatible with different generations of analog modems, illustrating Foxconn’s technology stack from communication modules and RF to antennas and system integration.

Looking ahead to space computing and AI applications, Foxconn said it will continue to leverage its strengths in AI, computing, communications, critical components, precision manufacturing, system integration and advanced thermal management, and will launch early‑stage research on high‑efficiency heat dissipation and thermal conduction. This prepares the company to extend AI data‑center technologies to satellite and space‑computing scenarios. Foxconn will also deepen collaboration with governments, academia, research institutes and international partners to gradually build the technical capabilities needed for next‑generation space communications and infrastructure, and to further expand into space‑computing opportunities.

items.title: 志聖營收重登10億元大關 10月營收10.13億元創同期新高年增80%
items.title_en: Zhi Sheng's Revenue Reclaims the NT$10 Billion Milestone; October Revenue Hits NT$10.13 Billion, a New Period High, Up 80% YoY
paras: 2026年前3季已賺回逾一個股本季台積電(2330-TW)供應鏈設備廠志聖(2467-TW)今(8)日公布最新營收資訊，志聖2026年10月營收重登10億元大關達10.13億元，歷史同期新高，月增7.21%，年增80.68%，2026年1-10月營收爲90.36億元，年增83.8%。
志聖2026年最新財報，1-9月營收爲80.23億元，年增84.2%，稅後純益16.61億元，年增1.91倍，每股純益已達10.67元。
志聖因應客戶全球擴產，志聖2026年進一步強化美國在地服務據點，並布局馬來西亞與新加坡東南亞平台，讓設備與服務能力貼近客戶。同時導入數位孿生（Digital Twin），將60年製程經驗轉化為可累積、重複運用的數位資產，推動設備開發由可視化、數據化走向物理模擬與AI應用。
同時，志聖表示，AI晶片封裝與高階PCB結構日益複雜，製程潔淨度、熱應力控制及量產良率成為關鍵。志聖推出自動壓膜、無吹氣自動撕膜、壓力烤箱及智慧無塵烤箱，展現材料處理、精準溫壓控制及自動化整合能力，協助客戶因應下一代製程需求。
志聖並表示，下一階段將以「支援AI製造，也應用AI」為發展方向，深化先進封裝與先進PCB布局。
由志聖、均豪精密(5443-TW)、均華精密(6640-TW))與東捷科技(8064-TW))組成的G2C+策略聯盟，其 AI 智慧製造與全球市場的布局。東捷已於2026年4月正式加入G2C+，其營運據點進一步串起台灣西部科技廊道沿線，使聯盟更貼近主要半導體產業聚落與客戶需求，也象徵G2C+從三家創始公司的合作基礎，邁向更完整的設備生態系。
志聖股價6日收盤價報304.5元，較前一昨日下跌33.5元或9.91%，成交量萎縮爲1064張。
設備廠陸續公布最新營收，牧德科技(3563-TW)2026年10月營收4.03 億元，月增 8.19% 、年增 95.59%，單月營收衝破4億大關且續創歷史新高，展現公司營運動能穩定，2026年1-10月營收爲34.08億元，己超越2025年全年營收，年增24.59%。
牧德估2026年第四季將成為公司2026年營運表現最旺的一季。
而也屬台積電供應鏈設備大廠迅得(6438-TW)營收在半導體業務推進一如預期，10 月營收維持在 6 億元以上高檔，以 6.73億元改寫歷史單月次高，也創同期新高，月減3.15%、年增28.08%；累計 2026 年 1-10 月營收達61.86億元，年增 10.93%。
paras_en: In the first three quarters of 2026, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company's (TSMC, 2330‑TW) supply‑chain equipment maker Zhi Sheng (2467‑TW) has already recouped more than one full year of earnings. Today (Oct. 8) the company announced its latest revenue figures: October 2026 revenue climbed back above the NT$10 billion mark to NT$10.13 billion, a historic high for the month, up 7.21% month‑over‑month and 80.68% year‑over‑year. For the January‑October period, revenue reached NT$90.36 billion, an 83.8% increase year‑over‑year.

Zhi Sheng's most recent financial report shows that revenue for January‑September 2026 was NT$80.23 billion, up 84.2% year‑over‑year, with after‑tax net profit of NT$16.61 billion, a 1.91‑times increase year‑over‑year. Earnings per share rose to NT$10.67.

To meet customers' global capacity expansions, Zhi Sheng further strengthened its on‑site service presence in the United States in 2026 and established platforms in Malaysia and Singapore to bring equipment and services closer to clients. The company also introduced Digital Twin technology, converting 60 years of process experience into cumulative, reusable digital assets, advancing equipment development from visualization and data‑driven approaches to physical simulation and AI applications.

Zhi Sheng added that AI chip packaging and advanced PCB structures are becoming increasingly complex, making process cleanliness, thermal‑stress control, and mass‑production yield critical. The firm launched automated lamination, blow‑free automatic film stripping, pressure ovens, and smart clean‑room ovens, showcasing capabilities in material handling, precise temperature‑pressure control, and automation integration to help customers meet next‑generation process demands.
The company further stated that its next development phase will focus on "supporting AI manufacturing while applying AI," deepening its layout in advanced packaging and advanced PCBs.

The G2C+ strategic alliance, composed of Zhi Sheng, Junhao Precision (5443‑TW), Junhua Precision (6640‑TW) and Dongjie Technology (8064‑TW), coordinates AI‑driven smart manufacturing and global market deployment. Dongjie officially joined G2C+ in April 2026, extending the alliance’s operational nodes along Taiwan’s western technology corridor, bringing the group closer to major semiconductor clusters and customer needs, and marking G2C+’s evolution from a three‑founder base to a more complete equipment ecosystem.
Zhi Sheng's stock closed at NT$304.5 on the 6th, down NT$33.5 or 9.91% from the previous session, with trading volume shrinking to 1,064 lots.

Equipment makers have been steadily reporting new revenues. Mu De Technology (3563‑TW) posted October 2026 revenue of NT$4.03 billion, up 8.19% month‑over‑month and 95.59% year‑over‑year, breaking the NT$4 billion threshold for the first time and setting a new historical high. For the January‑October period, its revenue reached NT$34.08 billion, surpassing the entire 2025 fiscal year and rising 24.59% year‑over‑year.
Mu De estimates that the fourth quarter of 2026 will be the strongest quarter for the company's overall performance that year.

Another major TSMC supply‑chain equipment supplier, Xun De (6438‑TW), saw semiconductor business progress as expected. October revenue stayed above NT$600 million, reaching a record‑high NT$673 million for a single month, also a new period high, down 3.15% month‑over‑month but up 28.08% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑October 2026 totaled NT$6.186 billion, a 10.93% increase year‑over‑year.

items.title: AI震撼回檔！全球股票ETF受益人不減反增「這檔」定期定額單月暴增1600人
items.title_en: AI Shock Pullback! Global Stock ETFs See Beneficiary Numbers Not Decrease but Increase, This ETF’s Regular Investment Subscribers Jumped 1,600 in One Month
paras: 近期全球科技股出現明顯回檔，AI行情邁入嚴格驗證期，全球股票型ETF因具備分散風險優勢，吸引大量投資人進場，帶動相關ETF受益人與定期定額人數雙雙增加。統計5檔全球股票型ETF截至9月底定期定額變化，貝萊德世界股票(009826-TW)定期定額人數大增超過1600人，最新人數達3823人，基金規模更衝破87億元大關，成為震盪市場中的熱門避風港。
市場專家分析，在近期5檔全球型ETF中，僅有009826持股數超過千檔，廣泛分散在近40個國家，並涵蓋大中小型股，相較於其他同類型ETF持股多落在50至100檔之間，009826讓投資人能以1檔ETF涵蓋全球近90%可投資市值。當科技股面臨回檔修正時，其高度分散的效果顯著，吸引定期定額人數與受益人在行情震盪時不減反增。
貝萊德世界股票(009826-TW)基金經理人楊貽甯表示，美國期中選舉後全球科技股震盪加劇，AI投資熱潮迎來市場嚴格檢視。然而，短線股價修正並不代表AI趨勢反轉，變革潛力仍持續看好。科技股賣壓並未全面擴散至所有產業，反映市場正進行明顯的產業輪動，投資布局須將過往高度集中於AI或少數科技巨頭的方式，擴大至不同產業。
楊貽甯指出，最新企業動態顯示AI資本支出與相關營收成長動能仍受關注，且生產力提升與應用機會正逐步由半導體、雲端運算等基礎建設，向電商、支付、醫療、工業等產業擴散。檢視009826投資範圍，涵蓋全球已開發及新興市場，截至2026年10月30日，除了資訊科技占比30.16%外，亦布局金融16.70%、工業10.62%、醫療保健9.39%及非必需消費8.51%，透過全球多元布局參與不同產業成長。
楊貽甯認為，在市場領先族群快速輪動之際，與其猜測下一個贏家，不如透過全球市場一次布局，降低單一市場與產業集中度，作為長期參與全球經濟與科技創新的核心配置。定期定額則是克服人性、降低擇時壓力的投資方式，透過紀律投入分散不同時點波動，避免追高殺低，讓投資人更有機會留在市場參與長期成長。

paras_en: Recently, global technology stocks have shown a noticeable pullback, putting the AI rally into a strict validation phase. Global equity ETFs, thanks to their risk‑diversification advantage, have attracted a large influx of investors, driving up both the number of ETF beneficiaries and regular‑investment participants. Statistics on five global equity ETFs up to the end of September show that BlackRock World Stock (009826‑TW) saw its regular‑investment subscriber count surge by more than 1,600, reaching 3,823, while its fund size broke the NT$8.7 billion mark, making it a popular safe haven in a volatile market.

Among the five global ETFs examined, only 009826 holds more than a thousand securities, spread across nearly 40 countries and covering large, mid‑ and small‑cap stocks. In contrast, peer ETFs typically hold between 50 and 100 securities. 009826 allows investors to capture roughly 90% of the investable global market with a single fund. When tech stocks undergo a correction, its high diversification proves especially effective, attracting more regular‑investment participants and beneficiaries even as the market wavers.

BlackRock World Stock fund manager Yang Yi‑ning said that after the U.S. mid‑term elections, global tech stocks have become more volatile and the AI investment frenzy is now under stricter market scrutiny. However, short‑term price corrections do not signal a reversal of the AI trend; the sector’s transformative potential remains strong. The selling pressure in tech has not spread to all industries, indicating a clear sector rotation, and investors should broaden their allocations beyond the previously AI‑centric or few‑tech‑giant focus.

Yang noted that the latest corporate data show AI capital expenditures and related revenue growth remain in focus, with productivity gains and application opportunities gradually expanding from semiconductor and cloud‑computing infrastructure to e‑commerce, payments, healthcare, and industrial sectors. Reviewing 009826’s holdings, it covers both developed and emerging markets; as of October 30, 2026, information technology accounts for 30.16% of the portfolio, while financials make up 16.70%, industrials 10.62%, healthcare 9.39% and consumer discretionary 8.51%, allowing participation in diverse industry growth worldwide.

Yang believes that when leading market groups rotate quickly, rather than guessing the next winner, investors should allocate once across the global market to reduce concentration in any single market or industry, forming a core long‑term position in the global economy and tech innovation. Regular‑investment plans help overcome behavioral biases and timing pressure, enabling disciplined, diversified contributions over different market moments, avoiding buying high and selling low, and giving investors a better chance to stay in the market for long‑term growth.

items.title: 法人：台股短線沉澱不改AI長期動能 宜採「多策略配置」迎戰高波動
items.title_en: Institutional View: Taiwan Market’s Short‑Term Pause Doesn’t Alter AI’s Long‑Term Momentum – Adopt “Multi‑Strategy Allocation” to Face High Volatility
paras: 受美股大跌及美國期中選舉後政策不確定性影響，台股6日陷入劇烈震盪，雖盤中在護盤資金挹注下急衝逾2,000點，終場仍重挫1,873.08點，失守4萬點大關。安聯投信指出，此波修正主因評價調整與資金沉澱，AI長線趨勢與台股企業獲利動能並未改變。面對高波動與產業分化加劇的市場環境，建議布局優先聚焦科技龍頭、半導體及AI供應鏈，並搭配金融等多元配置，以穩健掌握中長期結構性成長機會。
因應市場震盪，國安基金已決議進場護盤，國安基金自民國89年成立以來，總額維持5000億元，此次也是史上第十次進場，前一次為 2025 年4月9日川普祭出對等關稅。此外，金管會9日起亦將祭出限空令，包括調降每日盤中借券賣出委託數量上限，調高融券保證金成數，期望透過多項穩定措施，抑制極端空頭炒作，並同步擴大投資人補繳擔保品的管道，全力維護資本市場穩定。
安聯台灣大壩及台灣科技基金經理人蕭惠中分析，美國期中選舉後市場擔憂民主黨強化AI與資料中心監管，導致Nasdaq及費半指數劇烈修正，引發亞股恐慌性賣壓。然而，目前資料中心建設主要挑戰為成本上升而非投資放緩，加上供應鏈緊俏，對相關業者實質影響有限。
蕭惠中強調，本波修正反映政策不確定性、評價調整與籌碼沉澱，AI供應鏈短線承受評價壓力，但基本面與中長期獲利動能未變。台股2027年企業獲利成長動能依然強勁，短線待籌碼沉澱後，仍看好半導體、IP/ASIC、先進封裝、AI伺服器零組件及光通訊等產業龍頭與高業績能見度族群。
針對後市布局，安聯台灣高息成長主動式ETF(00984A-TW)經理人廖本隆指出，高評價下個股與產業表現將更趨分化。目前團隊以金融控股為最大配置以提高多元性、掌握輪動，成長股則涵蓋晶圓代工、先進封裝及散熱等科技鏈。
安聯台灣主動式ETF(00993A-TW)經理人郭勁甫補充，聯準會利率政策、美債殖利率及地緣政治仍為關鍵變數。在高利率、高評價與高波動環境下，企業獲利能見度將成為驗證關鍵，市場將由齊漲轉向個股分化，採多策略配置有助於穩健掌握結構性機會。

paras_en: Affected by the sharp drop in U.S. equities and policy uncertainty after the U.S. mid‑term elections, Taiwan’s stock market swung wildly on the 6th. Although it surged more than 2,000 points mid‑session thanks to protective capital inflows, it closed down 1,873.08 points, slipping below the 40,000‑point mark. Allianz Global Investors said the correction was mainly due to valuation adjustments and capital sedimentation, while the long‑term AI trend and earnings momentum of Taiwanese firms remain unchanged. In a high‑volatility, increasingly sector‑divergent environment, they recommend focusing on technology leaders, semiconductors and the AI supply chain, complemented by diversified allocations such as financials, to steadily capture mid‑ to long‑term structural growth opportunities.

In response to the market turbulence, the National Security Fund has decided to intervene for market support. Since its establishment in 2000, the fund has maintained a total size of NT$500 billion; this is its tenth intervention, the previous one occurring on April 9 2025 when President Trump imposed reciprocal tariffs. Moreover, starting on the 9th the Financial Supervisory Commission will impose short‑selling limits, including lowering the daily intraday borrowing‑sell order cap and raising the margin requirement for securities lending, aiming to curb extreme short‑selling activity, expand channels for investors to post additional collateral, and fully safeguard market stability.

Allianz Taiwan’s “Dam” and Technology Fund manager Hsu Hui‑Chung analyzed that after the U.S. mid‑term elections, market concerns that the Democratic Party might tighten AI and data‑center regulation led to a sharp correction in the Nasdaq and the PHI Semiconductor Index, sparking panic selling in Asian equities. However, the main challenge for data‑center construction now is rising costs rather than a slowdown in investment, and with a tight supply chain the actual impact on related companies is limited.

Hsu emphasized that the current correction reflects policy uncertainty, valuation adjustments and capital sedimentation. The AI supply chain faces short‑term valuation pressure, but fundamentals and mid‑ to long‑term earnings momentum remain intact. Taiwan’s corporate earnings growth outlook for 2027 stays strong; after capital settles, the outlook remains positive for semiconductor, IP/ASIC, advanced packaging, AI server components and optical communications leaders as well as high‑visibility earnings groups.

Regarding future positioning, Liou Pen‑Long, manager of Allianz Taiwan High‑Yield Growth Active ETF (00984A‑TW), noted that under high valuations individual stocks and sectors will diverge further. The team’s biggest allocation is to financial holding companies to boost diversification and capture rotation, while growth holdings cover wafer foundries, advanced packaging and cooling technologies within the tech chain.

Guo Jing‑Fu, manager of Allianz Taiwan Active ETF (00993A‑TW), added that Federal Reserve rate policy, U.S. Treasury yields and geopolitical factors remain key variables. In an environment of high rates, high valuations and high volatility, earnings visibility will be the decisive test, and the market will shift from broad rally to stock‑specific differentiation; a multi‑strategy allocation helps steadily capture structural opportunities.

items.title: 力晶投控爭取股東支持出招 庫藏股每股42元、股東會送1088元商品券
items.title_en: Licheng Investment Holdings Seeks Shareholder Support with Treasury Stock at NT$42 per Share and NT$1,088 Burger King Vouchers at AGM
paras: 力晶投控積極推動登錄興櫃，為爭取股東支持，11月25日臨時股東會祭出面額1,088元的漢堡王商品券作為股東會禮品，同時透過庫藏股及引進產業上下游友好廠商投資等方式，增加未上市股票流動性。力晶投控表示，總額10億元的庫藏股計畫已完成初步審查，符合資格的股東可依每股42元出售股票，預計11月20日支付股款；此外，近期也陸續接獲多家廠商表達投資意願，可望接續推出公開購買股權計畫。
力晶投控指出，日前推出的10億元庫藏股計畫，已完成初步審查，凡於截止申請前完成遞件且資料無誤的股東，均可依每股42元價格出售登記股數。審查合格通知函預計於9日寄出，股東後續可依通知辦理完稅及股票過戶，公司則將於11月20日匯出股款。
除庫藏股外，力晶投控也積極引進外部投資。針對山一投資日前宣布推出總額10億元的股權公開投資案，力晶投控表示，歡迎山一投資透過合法公開方式取得公司股權。
公司近期也陸續接獲產業上下游友好廠商的投資詢問，主要是看好力晶投控的基本面及未來發展，預期近期將有多家業者陸續推出公開購買股權計畫，提供未上市股票持有人更多交易及資金變現管道。
另一方面，力晶投控將於11月25日召開臨時股東會，討論修改公司章程及改選董監事等重大議案，相關決議攸關後續登錄興櫃規劃。為爭取股東參與及支持，公司此次也準備面額1,088元的漢堡王商品券作為股東會禮品，股東可持股東會通知書，至全通、長龍等委託書通路兌換。
力晶投控表示，登錄興櫃是公司未來發展的重要階段，也攸關全體股東權益，因此希望透過此次股東會凝聚共識，推動相關議案順利通過，朝興櫃及上市櫃目標邁進。
paras_en: Licheng Investment Holdings is actively pushing for listing on the Emerging Stock Board. To win shareholder support, the company’s extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on November 25 will offer Burger King vouchers worth NT$1,088 as a meeting gift. At the same time, it will increase liquidity of its unlisted shares through a treasury‑stock program and by attracting friendly upstream and downstream industry investors. Licheng says the NT$10 billion treasury‑stock plan has passed an initial review; eligible shareholders may sell shares at NT$42 each, with payment expected on November 20. In addition, several firms have recently expressed investment interest, paving the way for a public equity‑purchase program.

Licheng notes that the NT$10 billion treasury‑stock plan has completed its preliminary review. Shareholders who submit correct applications before the deadline may sell their registered shares at NT$42 per share. Notification letters confirming eligibility are slated to be mailed on the 9th, after which shareholders can settle taxes and transfer shares; the company will remit the proceeds on November 20.

Beyond the treasury‑stock initiative, Licheng is actively courting external investors. Regarding Shanyi Investment’s recent announcement of a NT$10 billion public equity‑investment project, Licheng welcomes Shanyi to acquire company shares through a lawful public offering.

The company has also been approached by several friendly firms along its industry’s supply chain, who are optimistic about Licheng’s fundamentals and future growth. It expects multiple parties to soon launch public equity‑purchase plans, giving holders of its unlisted stock more avenues for trading and cashing out.

On the other hand, Licheng will hold an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on November 25 to discuss major proposals such as amending the articles of incorporation and re‑electing directors and supervisors, matters critical to its upcoming Emerging Stock Board listing plan. To encourage participation and support, the company will provide Burger King vouchers worth NT$1,088 as a meeting gift; shareholders can present their meeting notices at authorized agents such as Quan‑Tong and Chang‑Long to redeem the vouchers.

Licheng states that listing on the Emerging Stock Board is a key stage in its development and vital to all shareholders’ interests. It hopes the meeting will build consensus and see the related proposals pass smoothly, moving the company toward its Emerging Board and eventual listed‑company goals.

items.title: 彰化等待20年！台76線全線通車 卓揆：打造「中部精密智慧新核心」關鍵拼圖
items.title_en: Changhua Awaits 20 Years! Taiwan Highway 76 Fully Opens; Premier Chou Says It Is a Key Piece in Building a “Central Precision‑Smart New Core”
paras: 行政院長卓榮泰昨（7）日親赴彰化縣主持「東西向快速公路台76線延伸工程」全線通車典禮。這項歷時長達20年規劃與施工、總經費耗資百億級的重要交通建設終於迎來歷史性時刻，不僅正式實現彰化地方鄉親長達20年的殷切期盼，更宣告串聯西濱台61線、台19線、國道1號及國道3號的完整東西向快速路網正式成形。卓榮泰強調，該工程兼顧產業發展、救災防洪及醫療轉診，期盼透過「海綿綠廊」、「人本環境」與「綠色路廊」三大工程特色，讓重大建設與自然環境永續共榮。

歷時20年打通彰化東西向交通大動脈

卓榮泰表示，回顧台76線的建設歷程，該公路最早可追溯至1991年「國家建設六年計畫」所規劃的12條東西向快速公路之一。自2005年八卦山隧道通車後，台19線以東至草屯路段率先通車；然而，台19線以西路段因受限於複雜的工程技術、地理環境、地方交通需求以及嚴格的財政考量，歷經漫長的20年才終於克服萬難全線完工。隨著全線正式通車，未來向西可無縫銜接西濱台61線，向東串聯台19線與國道1號、3號，徹底消弭過去交通運輸的斷點。

串聯三大產業園區，穩固中部精密智慧新核心

在產業發展的戰略佈局上，彰化縣在行政院推動的「六大區域產業及生活圈」計畫中，被精準劃定為「中部精密智慧新核心」。隨著台76線延伸段全線暢通，將能直接串聯芳苑工業區、中科二林園區及二林精密機械產業園區。卓榮泰表示，這不僅大幅縮短了重工業與科技產業的運輸時間，更有效提升整體產業發展量能，讓彰化縣在台灣全球知名的精密機械產業聚落中，繼續扮演不可或缺的關鍵樞紐角色。

破除「風頭水尾」困境，全面升級西南區防災韌性

針對彰化西南地區如芳苑鄉、大城鄉等沿海低窪地帶，由於缺乏天然山脈屏障，長久以來面臨台語俗稱「風頭水尾」的地理劣勢，極易受到季節性天然災害與強風豪雨侵擾。台76線全線通車後，將搖身一變成為兼具高效能的快速替代道路與救災主幹道。在災害發生時，能夠提供更迅速、更有力的交通支援與疏運能量，為當地民眾的生命財產安全與生活需求提供更周全的實質保障。

連結唯一醫學中心，加速急重症醫療轉診效率

在醫療資源與緊急救護的整合方面，彰化基督教醫院作為彰化、南投、雲林三縣市唯一的醫學中心，肩負極為門王沉重的急重症救治任務。雖然當地另有秀傳醫院、員林基督教醫院及二林基督教醫院等重要醫療院所，但面對重大傷病與跨區轉診需求時，黃金救援時間往往是關鍵。台76線全線通車後，將大幅提升跨區醫療網的交通運輸效率，讓偏鄉及沿海地區居民在面對突發急難時，能享有更快速、更安心的醫療轉送保障。

落實永續與美學：海綿綠廊、人本環境與綠色路廊

除了交通運輸與產業經濟的功能外，此項重大公共工程更融入了現代永續發展的設計思維，完整涵蓋三大亮點特色。首先是具備強大滯洪、蓄水及防災功能的「海綿綠廊」；其次是在「人本環境」上，透過橋面下增設照明設備及路口行人穿越線退縮等具體措施，體現以人為本的交通哲學；最後則是善用橋下空間規劃自行車道、人行道與兒童遊憩設施的「綠色路廊」，為國人創造出全新的生活與休憩綠帶。

持續深化地方建設藍圖，中央與地方攜手並進

行政院積極傾聽地方心聲，彰化縣長王惠美今年9月曾親赴行政院與卓揆會談，當面提出包含員林自行車產業園區開發、水五金田園生產聚落特定區計畫、高速公路彰化交流道附近特定區計畫、擴大彰化市都市計畫以及大眾捷運系統整體路網計畫等11項重大地方建設需求。卓揆強調，中央將持續依據雙方共商的建設藍圖穩健推進，展現中央與地方攜手合作、共同帶動地方繁榮的堅定決心。
paras_en: Premier Chou Rong‑tai personally attended the opening ceremony in Changhua County yesterday for the full opening of the east‑west expressway extension of Highway 76. The project, a major transportation undertaking that took 20 years of planning and construction and cost hundreds of billions of NT$, finally reached a historic milestone, fulfilling the long‑standing hopes of local residents and completing an east‑west rapid‑road network that links the West Coast Highway 61, Highway 19, National Freeway 1 and National Freeway 3. Chou emphasized that the project balances industrial development, disaster‑prevention flood control and medical referrals, and hopes its three hallmark features – the “sponge green corridor,” “human‑centered environment,” and “green corridor” – will allow major construction and the natural environment to thrive together sustainably.

Looking back over the 20‑year journey to open Changhua’s east‑west traffic artery, Chou noted that Highway 76 traces its origins to the 1991 “Six‑Year National Construction Plan,” which listed twelve east‑west expressways. After the Bagua Mountain Tunnel opened in 2005, the eastern segment of Highway 19 to Caotun was completed first. However, the western segment of Highway 19 faced complex engineering challenges, difficult terrain, local traffic needs and strict budget constraints, taking another two decades to overcome and finish the entire route. With the full opening, the highway now seamlessly connects westward to the West Coast Highway 61 and eastward to Highway 19 and Freeways 1 and 3, eliminating previous transportation gaps.

In terms of industrial strategy, Changhua County has been designated in the Executive Yuan’s “Six Regional Industries and Living Circles” plan as the “Central Precision‑Smart New Core.” The completed extension of Highway 76 will directly link the Fangyuan Industrial Park, the second phase of the National Chung‑Hsing University (NCHU) Erlin Park, and the Erlin Precision Machinery Industrial Park. Chou said this will dramatically shorten transport times between heavy‑industry and high‑tech sectors, boost overall industrial capacity, and keep Changhua a vital hub in Taiwan’s globally recognized precision‑machinery cluster.

The southwest part of Changhua, including coastal low‑lying areas such as Fangyuan and Dacheng Townships, has long suffered from the geographic disadvantage locally called “wind‑head, water‑tail,” making it highly vulnerable to seasonal natural disasters, strong winds and heavy rain due to the lack of natural mountain barriers. With Highway 76 fully opened, the road will become a high‑performance rapid‑detour and disaster‑relief artery, providing faster, stronger traffic support and evacuation capability during emergencies, thereby offering more comprehensive protection for residents’ lives, property and daily needs.

Regarding medical resources and emergency transport, Changhua Christian Hospital serves as the sole medical center for Changhua, Nantou and Yunlin counties, bearing a heavy burden of critical‑care treatment. Although other important hospitals such as Show Chwan, Yuanlin Christian, and Erlin Christian exist, the golden rescue window is crucial for severe injuries and inter‑regional transfers. The full opening of Highway 76 will greatly improve the efficiency of cross‑regional medical transport, allowing residents in remote and coastal areas to receive faster, more reliable emergency medical transfers.

Beyond transportation and economic functions, the project incorporates modern sustainable‑development design with three key highlights. First, the “sponge green corridor” provides strong flood‑storage, water‑retention and disaster‑mitigation capabilities. Second, the “human‑centered environment” adds lighting under bridges and retractable pedestrian crossing markings to embody a people‑first traffic philosophy. Third, the “green corridor” makes use of bridge‑under spaces for bike lanes, sidewalks and children’s play facilities, creating new green belts for recreation and daily life.

The Executive Yuan continues to listen to local voices. In September, Changhua County Mayor Wang Huimei visited the Executive Yuan to discuss eleven major local‑construction needs, including the development of a bike‑industry park in Yuanlin, a specific‑area plan for the Water‑Hardware agricultural zone, a designated zone near the Changhua freeway interchange, an expansion of Changhua City’s urban plan, and a comprehensive mass‑transit network. Premier Chou stressed that the central government will steadily advance the jointly‑crafted construction blueprint, demonstrating a firm commitment to central‑local cooperation and shared regional prosperity.

Model giants expand compute procurement, in‑house TPU and Tier‑2 ecosystem taking shape

items.title: 頻率元件廠營運及獲利改善 繼安碁後台嘉碩及泰藝都將發CB籌資
items.title_en: Frequency Component Makers See Operational and Profit Improvements; Following Anci, Tai Jia Shuo and Tai Yi Plan CB Fundraising
paras: 頻率元件廠2026年來營運獲改善，其中晶技(3042-TW)在1-3季賺回逾半個股本，每股純益達5.04元，而台嘉碩 (3221-TW) 及泰藝(8289-TW)都較去年同期由虧轉盈，2027年在AI等需求也不看淡，台嘉碩及泰藝陸續提發可轉債(CB)的市場籌資規劃。
台嘉碩及泰藝陸續提出發可轉債(CB)的市場籌資規劃，其中台嘉碩擬發行無擔保可轉換公司債，自市場募集約 3.57 億元，而泰藝也擬發無擔保可轉換公司債4億元，而加計安碁(6174-TW) 已完成以發行CB籌資3.06億元，2026年頻率元件業者自市場籌資金額超過 10億元。
泰藝2026年第三季稅後純益4468萬元，超過上半年稅後純益總和的4334萬元，2026年1-3季財報營收15.9億元，稅後純益8801萬元，較去年同期由虧轉盈，每股純益1.28元。
台喜碩2026年第三季較去年同期由虧轉盈，稅後純益 2050 萬元，每股純益 0.2 元，前三季稅後純益達 1.06 億元，也較2025年同期轉盈，每股純益 1.02 元；台嘉碩，持續看好低軌衛星(LEO)及AI需求擴增，台嘉碩預估2027年低軌衛星客戶並將增加。
台嘉碩認為 2027 年爲低軌衛星產業的高度起飛年度，目前看來無論衛星及相關地面通訊基地台的發射數量及建設，在 2026 年下半年都明顯提升，並在 2027 年爆發大需求。目前台嘉碩的低軌衛星客戶6家，其中3家並已開始出貨，，LEO通訊需求將持續放量，公司認為2027年低軌衛星客戶並將再增加。
同時，在AI光通訊應用上，台嘉碩目前156.25MHz低抖動石英振盪器已經量產出貨，312.5MHz石英振盪器正送交客戶評估，期望在2027年上半年得以完成客戶端認證並且出貨貢獻營收；同時台嘉碩自行開發的625MHz表面聲波振盪器也已進入送樣階段。
安碁科技是2026年首家完成籌資案的石英元件廠，完成發行無擔保可轉換公司債募集3.06億元，
安碁科技積極擴充營運能量，今年上半年營收3.64億元，稅後純益3854萬元，年增3.72倍，每股純益0.77元，獲利表現明顯成長。安碁在產品布局方面，安碁科技長期深耕少量多樣、高單價及高品質要求的應用市場，其中車用產品占營收比重約52%，工業控制產品則占12%。法人指出，隨著車用石英元件價量提升趨勢成形，安碁科技可望成為主要受惠廠商之一。
paras_en: Frequency component makers have seen operational improvements in 2026, with Jingji (3042-TW) earning back more than half of its share capital in Q1‑Q3, posting earnings per share of NT$5.04. Both Tai Jia Shuo (3221-TW) and Tai Yi (8289-TW) turned from loss to profit compared with the same period last year, and they remain optimistic about AI‑driven demand in 2027, outlining market fundraising plans via convertible bonds (CB).

Tai Jia Shuo and Tai Yi have each outlined market fundraising plans using convertible bonds. Tai Jia Shuo intends to issue unsecured convertible corporate bonds to raise about NT$357 million, while Tai Yi plans to issue unsecured convertible corporate bonds for NT$400 million. Including Anci (6174‑TW), which has already completed a CB raise of NT$306 million, total market fundraising by frequency component firms in 2026 exceeds NT$1 billion.

Tai Yi posted a Q3 2026 after‑tax profit of NT$44.68 million, surpassing the combined after‑tax profit of the first half of the year (NT$43.34 million). For the first three quarters, revenue reached NT$1.59 billion and after‑tax profit was NT$88.01 million, a turnaround from a loss a year earlier, yielding earnings per share of NT$1.28.

Tai Jia Shuo reported a Q3 2026 turnaround to profit, with after‑tax earnings of NT$20.5 million and earnings per share of NT$0.20. For the first three quarters, after‑tax profit totaled NT$106 million, also a reversal from 2025, with earnings per share of NT$1.02. The company remains confident about growing demand for low‑earth‑orbit (LEO) satellites and AI, and forecasts an increase in LEO satellite customers in 2027.

Tai Jia Shuo believes 2027 will be a breakout year for the LEO satellite industry. Launch and ground‑station construction activity already rose noticeably in the second half of 2026 and is expected to surge in 2027. The company currently serves six LEO satellite customers, three of which have begun shipments, and expects the number of LEO customers to grow further in 2027.

In AI optical‑communication applications, Tai Jia Shuo has begun mass production and shipment of its 156.25 MHz low‑jitter quartz oscillator, while its 312.5 MHz quartz oscillator is under customer evaluation, with certification and shipments targeted for the first half of 2027. Its in‑house developed 625 MHz surface‑acoustic‑wave oscillator has also entered the sample‑delivery stage.
Anci Technology became the first quartz‑component maker to complete a fundraising round in 2026, issuing unsecured convertible corporate bonds that raised NT$306 million.

Anci Technology is actively expanding its operational capacity. In the first half of this year it generated NT$364 million in revenue and NT$38.54 million in after‑tax profit, a year‑over‑year increase of 3.72 times, with earnings per share of NT$0.77. The company focuses on low‑volume, high‑mix, high‑price, high‑quality markets; automotive products account for about 52% of revenue and industrial‑control products about 12%. Analysts note that as the volume and price of automotive quartz components rise, Anci is well positioned to be a major beneficiary.

items.title: AI股暴跌該買？Yardeni喊進、花旗示警 五大分析師觀點一次看
items.title_en: AI Stocks Plunge: Should You Buy? Yardeni Calls for Entry, Citi Warns; Five Top Analyst Views in One Look
paras: 人工智慧 (AI) 類股遭遇猛烈拋售後，華爾街對進場時機看法分歧。Yardeni Research 認為，資料中心面臨的政治阻力只是 AI 投資熱潮的「減速丘」，股價重挫提供買進機會；花旗則警告，AI 融資疑慮與建設變數尚未消退，科技股仍可能承壓，現階段較看好歐股。
美股週四 (5 日) 遭遇大屠殺，道瓊工業指數重挫 1,833.06 點，標普 500 指數下跌約 4.4%，創 2025 年 4 月關稅衝擊以來最差單日表現，那斯達克指數重挫約 5.5%，較 10 月高點回落約 11.9%，正式跌入修正區間。
《Investing.com》整理華爾街五大 AI 相關分析師觀點指出，除了資料中心建設前景，企業併購代價、AI 商業化能力與軟體需求也成為市場焦點。
Yardeni Research：AI基建只是減速，暴跌提供買進機會
Yardeni Research 表示，自 9 月 15 日起便建議投資人在期中選舉前保持謹慎，並預期選後將出現買進機會。週三股市在空頭回補帶動下上漲，隨後卻急轉直下。
該機構形容：「我們先前警告，民主黨大勝後可能會潑了一盆冷水，這盆水只是晚了一點到。」
Yardeni 指出，投資人開始反映民主黨勝選對美國經濟「金雞母」，也就是 AI 投資熱潮的影響。
該機構引述 NBC 出口民調稱，76% 選民反對在居住社區興建新的資料中心，凸顯地方反彈正在升高。
其中，德州約占美國 2028 年規劃新增資料中心容量的近 30%，新當選州長 Gina Hinojosa 曾承諾暫停核准新案。
Yardeni 並引述高盛估算，可能面臨限制的州，占美國規劃中資料中心容量約 45%。
不過，Yardeni 認為，政治反彈、融資限制及實體建設瓶頸，都只是 AI 熱潮的「減速丘」，市場賣壓已經過頭。
「資料中心仍會興建，只是速度會慢一些。減速丘應有助避免 AI 熱潮衝得太快，在下一個彎道失控。」該機構表示：「這就是我們將上週四拋售視為買進機會的原因。」
TD Cowen、美銀：Marvell遭降評，收購代價偏高
Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) 以全股票方式收購 Lumentum (LITE-US) 的交易，引發分析師對股權稀釋、收購時機與整合效益的疑慮，TD Cowen 與美銀證券均調降評等。
TD Cowen 將 Marvell 由「買進」降至「持有」，目標價由 350 美元大砍至 175 美元。分析師 Sean O’Loughlin 預估，交易在 2028 年首年將使每股盈餘稀釋約中個位數百分比，並擔心收購時點可能接近光通訊短期景氣循環的高峰。
他表示：「我們降評主要是因為對交易結構與時機抱持負面看法，而非質疑 Marvell 所收購資產的品質。」
O’Loughlin 認為，Lumentum 有望成為 Marvell 產品組合中的「皇冠明珠」，但市場對光通訊成長的預期可能過高。依各公司預估加總推算，市場共識隱含 2027 年光收發模組市場規模約達 1,000 億美元，遠高於 TD Cowen 預估的 470 億美元。
若景氣反轉，Lumentum 的營運槓桿可能放大獲利下滑，進一步加重每股盈餘稀釋壓力。
美銀證券則將 Marvell 由「買進」降至「中立」，目標價由 400 美元調降至 225 美元。
分析師 Vivek Arya 肯定交易可建立更完整的電訊號至光訊號連接平台，但指出，交易預計至 2028 年上半年才完成，漫長監管審查可能使股價持續承壓。
Arya 也認為，約 10 億美元成本撙節不足以抵銷約 50% 的股數增加，每股盈餘增益有限，另須留意潛在客戶利益衝突。
他表示，Marvell 最近的分析師日並未提及大型併購，因此這項消息「相當令人意外」，並質疑：「當雷射供應短缺終究獲得解決後，Lumentum 的估值會受到什麼影響？」
花旗：AI賣壓恐未結束，歐股較具吸引力
對整體市場，花旗認為，不能僅依歷史上的期中選舉行情，就預期美股將持續反彈。
該行指出，歷史季節性分析顯示，標普 500 指數在期中選舉年的 11 月至 12 月通常上漲約 3% 至 4%，但今年選前回檔的原因有所不同。
「更重要的是，期中選舉前的回落，主要並非選舉因素，而是 AI 融資疑慮與油價。」花旗表示。
花旗仍預期，強勁運算需求將支持資料中心持續興建，但民主黨勝選後，建設地點、設計與施工速度都可能改變。
該行直言，這對提供 AI 基礎建設所需設備的供應商，包括半導體業者，「遠非理想情況」。
此外，花旗追蹤標普 500 七大權值股中，有多少檔跌破 200 日均線的「Generals」指標，已接近發出警戒訊號，預期資金短期內仍將從科技股轉出。
相較之下，花旗較偏好歐股，認為油價大幅回落對歐洲企業與經濟的助益更大，也可能讓歐洲央行採取更偏向寬鬆的立場。
「由於 AI 題材仍面臨困境，而油價大跌對歐股的幫助更大，我們偏好透過歐洲市場布局。」花旗表示，至少預期歐股表現將優於美股。
花旗：Adobe恐迎營運大重整，降評至「賣出」
花旗另將 Adobe (ADBE-US) 評等調降至「賣出」，目標價由 250 美元降至 207 美元，認為管理層交接、競爭加劇與總體經濟壓力，可能使市場對 2027 會計年度成長的預估面臨下修。
分析師指出，Anil Chakravarthy 將於 12 月 1 日接任執行長，但公司同時面臨財務長與數位媒體部門主管等重要職位空缺。
「我們認為，出現大幅重整的風險正在升高。」花旗表示，Adobe 於 12 月初公布第四季財報時，可能提出較疲弱的 2027 會計年度展望。
花旗預期，Adobe 將更倚重 AI 與 Firefly 擴大潛在用戶及月活躍用戶規模，過去仰賴 Creative Cloud 漲價的成長模式則可能轉變。不過，新用戶轉為付費客戶需要時間，加上小型企業需求疲弱，以及網頁式、AI 原生工具競爭，短期內可能壓抑年度經常性收入 (ARR) 成長。
該行估算，轉向用戶成長的策略，可能使 2027 會計年度 ARR 成長率承受約 2 個百分點壓力；先前 Creative Cloud 漲價效益逐漸消退，還可能帶來額外約 0.5 個百分點逆風。
花旗將 Adobe 2027 與 2028 會計年度淨新增 ARR 預估，分別下修約 4.7 億與 5 億美元，降至 15 億及 13.5 億美元；整體 ARR 年增率則估為 5.3% 與 4.5%，較市場預期低約 2 至 3 個百分點。
此外，尚未有效變現的 AI 推論成本，也使花旗將 2027 會計年度非一般公認會計原則 (non-GAAP) 毛利率預估下修 0.7 個百分點。
花旗認為，若公司大幅重整，短期將壓抑股價，但也能爭取時間重建領導團隊、調整策略，並建立較容易達成的成長基礎。
BTIG 等四家機構：企業軟體支出環境持續承壓
HubSpot (HUBS-US) 因第四季展望低於預期，遭 BTIG、KeyBanc、Cantor 與摩根士丹利接連調降評等，反映企業軟體支出環境持續承壓。
HubSpot 第三季固定匯率營收成長 17%，較市場預期高出 2 個百分點，但第四季成長指引降至 12%，低於市場預估的 13.8%。
管理層表示，客戶預算審查更嚴格、對價格更敏感，銷售週期也進一步拉長，這些情況可能延續至 2027 年。
公司第三季淨新增客戶 5,300 家，低於預期的 5,600 家，第四季預估將少於 5,000 家；淨營收留存率則由去年同期的 103% 降至 101%，顯示既有客戶帶來的營收擴張動能減弱。
BTIG 將評等由「買進」降至「中立」，並將 2027 年成長預估由 14% 下修至 11%。分析師 Nick Altmann 認為，以約 10 倍的 2027 年預估自由現金流估值來看，目前股價已屬合理。
KeyBanc 分析師 Jackson Ader 將評等降至「與產業相當」，表示：「我們承認這次降評較晚，但在明年 2 月正式公布 2027 年財測前，我們認為改善空間有限。」
Cantor 將 HubSpot 降至「減碼」，目標價設為 170 美元。
分析師 Matthew VanVliet 指出，公司新的歐洲定價實際上相當於降價，AI 工具的表現也落後同業。
「我們不再將 HubSpot 視為值得市場持續給予信任的頂尖 SaaS 企業。」他表示。
摩根士丹利也將HubSpot評等由「加碼」降至「中立」，目標價由 287 美元調降至 229 美元。
paras_en: After a fierce sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, Wall Street is split on timing a market entry. Yardeni Research sees the political resistance facing data centers as merely a "slow‑down hill" in the AI investment boom, making the price drop a buying opportunity; Citi warns that AI financing concerns and construction variables have not faded, tech stocks may still be under pressure, and it currently favors European equities.

U.S. equities suffered a massacre on Thursday (the 5th), with the Dow Jones Industrial Average plunging 1,833.06 points, the S&P 500 falling about 4.4% – its worst single‑day performance since the tariff shock of April 2025 – and the Nasdaq tumbling roughly 5.5%, retreating about 11.9% from its October peak and officially entering correction territory.

Investing.com compiled five major Wall Street analyst viewpoints on AI, noting that beyond data‑center construction prospects, corporate‑M&A pricing, AI commercialization capabilities and software demand have also become market focal points.
Yardeni Research: AI infrastructure is only slowing, the crash offers a buying chance

Yardeni Research said it has been urging investors to stay cautious ahead of the midterm elections since September 15 and expects buying opportunities after the election. The market rose on Wednesday on short‑covering, then sharply reversed.
The firm described it as: "We warned that a big Democratic win might pour a bucket of cold water, only that the water arrived a bit later."
Yardeni noted investors are beginning to reflect on how a Democratic victory could act as a "golden goose" for the U.S. economy, influencing the AI investment surge.
The firm cited an NBC poll showing 76% of voters oppose building new data centers in their residential neighborhoods, highlighting rising local backlash.
Texas accounts for nearly 30% of the U.S. planned new data‑center capacity by 2028, and the newly elected governor Gina Hinojosa has pledged to pause approvals for new projects.
Yardeni also quoted Goldman Sachs estimating that states likely to impose restrictions represent about 45% of the planned U.S. data‑center capacity.
However, Yardeni believes political pushback, financing limits and physical‑construction bottlenecks are merely "slow‑down hills" in the AI boom, and market selling pressure is now overdone.

"Data centers will still be built, just at a slower pace. The slowdown hill should help prevent the AI frenzy from accelerating too fast and losing control on the next bend," the firm said, adding: "That’s why we view last Thursday’s sell‑off as a buying opportunity."
TD Cowen and BofA: Marvell downgraded, acquisition price seen as high

Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US)’s all‑stock acquisition of Lumentum (LITE‑US) has sparked analyst concerns over equity dilution, timing and integration benefits, prompting TD Cowen and Bank of America Securities to cut their ratings.

TD Cowen lowered Marvell from "Buy" to "Hold" and slashed the target price from $350 to $175. Analyst Sean O’Loughlin estimates the deal will dilute EPS by a low‑single‑digit percentage in 2028’s first year and worries the timing may coincide with the peak of the short‑term optical‑communications cycle.
He said, "We downgrade mainly because of a negative view on the deal structure and timing, not because we doubt the quality of the assets Marvell is acquiring."

O’Loughlin believes Lumentum could become the "crown jewel" of Marvell’s product portfolio, but market expectations for optical‑communications growth may be overstated. Summing company forecasts, consensus implies a 2027 optical transceiver market of about $100 billion, far above TD Cowen’s $47 billion estimate.
If the cycle turns, Lumentum’s operating leverage could amplify profit declines, further increasing EPS dilution pressure.
BofA Securities cut Marvell from "Buy" to "Neutral" and reduced the target price from $400 to $225.

Analyst Vivek Arya praised the deal’s potential to create a more complete electrical‑to‑optical signal platform, but warned the transaction won’t close until the first half of 2028, and a lengthy regulatory review could keep the stock under pressure.

Arya also noted that roughly $1 billion in cost savings is insufficient to offset about a 50% increase in share count, limiting EPS accretion, and flagged potential conflicts of interest with customers.

He said Marvell’s recent analyst day didn’t mention a large acquisition, making the news "quite surprising," and questioned: "When laser‑supply shortages are finally resolved, how will Lumentum’s valuation be affected?"
Citi: AI selling pressure may not be over, European stocks look more attractive
Regarding the broader market, Citi believes one cannot assume a continued U.S. rally solely based on historical midterm‑election patterns.

The bank points out that seasonal analysis shows the S&P 500 typically gains about 3%‑4% from November to December in election years, but this year’s pre‑election pullback stemmed from different reasons.
"More importantly, the pre‑election dip was driven not by the election itself but by AI financing concerns and oil prices," Citi said.
Citi still expects strong computing demand to support ongoing data‑center construction, yet a Democratic win could alter locations, designs and build speeds.
The firm bluntly stated this is far from ideal for suppliers of AI‑infrastructure equipment, including semiconductor makers.

Additionally, Citi tracks how many of the S&P 500’s seven mega‑caps have fallen below their 200‑day moving average – the "Generals" metric – which is nearing a warning signal, suggesting capital may continue shifting out of tech stocks in the short term.
By contrast, Citi leans toward European equities, believing the sharp oil‑price decline benefits European companies and economies more and could push the ECB toward a more accommodative stance.

"Because AI themes still face headwinds and oil‑price drops help European stocks more, we prefer positioning through the European market," Citi said, expecting European performance to at least outpace U.S. stocks.
Citi: Adobe likely to undergo major restructuring, rating cut to "Sell"

Citi also downgraded Adobe (ADBE‑US) to "Sell," lowering the target price from $250 to $207, citing management turnover, heightened competition and macro‑economic pressure that could force a downgrade of its FY 2027 growth outlook.
Analysts note that Anil Chakravarthy will assume the CEO role on Dec 1, while the company also faces vacancies for CFO and digital‑media head positions.
"We see the risk of a significant restructuring rising," Citi said, adding that Adobe’s Q4 earnings release in early December may present a weaker FY 2027 outlook.

Citi expects Adobe to rely more on AI and Firefly to expand its potential and monthly active user base, while its historic growth model of Creative Cloud price hikes may shift. However, converting new users to paying customers takes time, and weak demand from small businesses, plus competition from web‑based and AI‑native tools, could suppress ARR growth in the near term.

The bank estimates that the shift toward user‑growth could shave roughly 2 percentage points off FY 2027 ARR growth, while the fading benefit of Creative Cloud price hikes could add another 0.5‑point headwind.

Citi trimmed Adobe’s FY 2027 and FY 2028 net new ARR forecasts by about $470 million and $500 million respectively, to $1.5 billion and $1.35 billion; overall ARR growth rates are now seen at 5.3% and 4.5%, roughly 2‑3 points below market expectations.
Furthermore, un‑realized AI inference costs led Citi to lower its FY 2027 non‑GAAP gross‑margin estimate by 0.7 percentage points.
Citi believes a major restructuring would weigh on the stock in the short term but would also buy time to rebuild the leadership team, adjust strategy and lay a more achievable growth foundation.
BTIG and three other firms: Corporate software spending remains under pressure
HubSpot (HUBS‑US) saw its rating cut by BTIG, KeyBanc, Cantor and Morgan Stanley after a Q4 outlook that fell short of expectations, reflecting continued pressure on corporate software spending.
HubSpot’s Q3 constant‑currency revenue grew 17%, beating market forecasts by 2 points, but its Q4 growth guide was lowered to 12%, below the consensus 13.8% estimate.
Management said customers are tightening budget reviews, becoming more price‑sensitive, and lengthening sales cycles, trends that could persist into 2027.

The company added 5,300 net new customers in Q3, below the expected 5,600, and projects fewer than 5,000 in Q4; net revenue retention slipped from 103% a year ago to 101%, indicating weaker expansion from existing accounts.

BTIG downgraded the rating from "Buy" to "Neutral" and cut the 2027 growth outlook from 14% to 11%. Analyst Nick Altmann said that at roughly a 10‑times 2027 free‑cash‑flow valuation, the current share price appears reasonable.

KeyBanc analyst Jackson Ader lowered the rating to "Equal‑Weight," noting, "We acknowledge this downgrade comes later, but ahead of the formal FY 2027 guidance in February, we see limited upside potential."
Cantor reduced HubSpot to "Underweight" with a target price of $170.
Analyst Matthew VanVliet pointed out that the company’s new European pricing is effectively a discount and its AI tools lag behind peers.
"We no longer view HubSpot as a top‑tier SaaS company worthy of continued market confidence," he said.
Morgan Stanley also cut HubSpot’s rating from "Overweight" to "Neutral," lowering the target price from $287 to $229.

items.title: 美國債務警報拉響！華爾街估恐觸發「非常規措施」 債限上限最快提前至明年2月觸頂
items.title_en: U.S. Debt Alert Sounds! Wall Street Warns of Possible "Extraordinary Measures" as Debt Ceiling May Hit Its Peak as Early as February Next Year
paras: 華爾街最新預警，美國財政部最快將於2027年2月中下旬觸及41.1兆美元法定債務上限，較原先市場預期明顯提前，屆時須啟動「非常規措施」避開融資斷鏈。
美銀、巴克莱與摩根士丹利策略師指出，美國財政部最新融資估算與偏高的現金餘額，是觸頂時點前移的主因；其中美銀原估5月前後，如今時間已大幅提前。
目前，美國政府距債限僅剩不到8000億美元，財政部上週公布明年第一季淨借款約8000億美元，3月底現金餘額目標訂為1兆美元歷史高位。
若國會未提高或暫停債限，財政部可動用非常規會計手段，額外騰出3000億至3500億美元緩衝。
